sentences.zh: 廣順元年冬十月己丑朔，宰臣王峻獻唐張蘊古《大寶箴》、謝偃《惟皇誡德賦》二圖。

translations.literal: In the first year of Guangshun, on the jichou day, the new moon of the tenth month of winter, Grand Councilor Wang Jun presented two illustrated scrolls: Tang Zhang Wenggu's Admonition on the Great Treasure and Xie Yan's Rhapsody Admonishing the Sovereign's Virtue.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the tenth month of winter in the first year of Guangshun, Grand Councilor Wang Jun presented two illustrated works from the Tang—Zhang Wenggu's Admonition on the Great Treasure and Xie Yan's Rhapsody Admonishing the Sovereign's Virtue.

sentences.zh: 詔報曰：「朕生長軍戎，勤勞南北，雖用心於《鈐》、《匱》，且無暇於《詩》、《書》，世務時艱，粗經閱歷，前言往行，未甚討尋。

translations.literal: An edict in reply said: "I grew up amid the armies and have toiled north and south; though I have applied my mind to military manuals and stratagems, I have had no leisure for the Odes and Documents. The affairs of the age and its hardships I have only roughly experienced, and the words and deeds of former ages I have not greatly investigated.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied by edict: "I was raised in the military camps and have labored on campaigns north and south. Though I have given my attention to manuals of war and strategy, I have had little time for the Odes and Documents. I have only a rough acquaintance with the hardships of our times, and I have not deeply studied the wisdom of former ages.

sentences.zh: 卿有佐命立國之勛，居代天調鼎之任，恒慮眇德，未及古人。

translations.literal: You have the merit of aiding the Mandate and founding the state, and hold the charge of regulating the realm on Heaven's behalf; I constantly fear that my slight virtue does not reach that of the ancients.
translations.idiomatic: You aided the founding of the dynasty and now bear the weight of governing the realm in Heaven's stead; I constantly worry that my modest virtue falls short of the ancients.

sentences.zh: 於是采掇箴規，弼諧寡昧，披文閱理，懌意怡神，究為君治國之源，審修己御人之要。

translations.literal: Therefore you have gathered admonitions and rules to assist and harmonize my dullness; unfolding the text and examining its principles delights the mind and refreshes the spirit, investigating the source of governing the state as ruler and discerning the essentials of cultivating oneself and controlling others.
translations.idiomatic: You have therefore gathered these admonitions to guide my limited understanding. Reading them has delighted and refreshed me, for they probe the roots of kingship and statecraft and clarify what it means to cultivate oneself and govern others.

sentences.zh: 帝王之道，盡在於茲，辭翰俱高，珠寶何貴！

translations.literal: The way of emperors and kings is wholly contained herein; both compositions are lofty in diction—what need is there for pearls and jewels!
translations.idiomatic: The way of emperors and kings is fully set forth here. Both works are superb in style—what could pearls and jewels add?

sentences.zh: 再三省覽，深用愧嘉。

translations.literal: Having repeatedly examined them, I am deeply moved to shame and gratitude.
translations.idiomatic: I have read them again and again and am deeply humbled and grateful.

sentences.zh: 其所進圖，已令於行坐處張懸，所冀出入看讀，用為鑒戒。

translations.literal: The scrolls you presented have been ordered hung in the places where I walk and sit; my hope is to read them coming and going and take them as a mirror and warning.
translations.idiomatic: I have ordered your scrolls hung wherever I walk or sit, so that I may read them at every turn and keep their lessons before me.

sentences.zh: 」壬辰，潞州奏，巡檢使陳思讓、監軍向訓破河東賊軍於虒亭。

translations.literal: " On the renchen day, Luzhou reported that Inspection Commissioner Chen Siyang and Army Supervisor Xiang Xun defeated the Hedong rebel army at Siting.
translations.idiomatic: " On renchen, Luzhou reported that Inspection Commissioner Chen Siyang and Army Supervisor Xiang Xun had routed the Hedong rebel forces at Siting.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以刑部侍郎司徒詡為戶部侍郎，以左散騎常侍張煦為刑部侍郎，以給事中呂咸休為左散騎常侍。

translations.literal: On the guisi day, Vice Minister of Justice Situ Xu was made Vice Minister of Revenue; Left Honorary Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary Zhang Xu was made Vice Minister of Justice; and Drafting Counselor Lü Xianxiu was made Left Honorary Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Situ Xu was transferred from Vice Minister of Justice to Vice Minister of Revenue; Zhang Xu moved from Left Honorary Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary to Vice Minister of Justice; and Drafting Counselor Lü Xianxiu was appointed Left Honorary Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary.

sentences.zh: 甲午，絳州防禦使孫漢英卒。

translations.literal: On the jiawu day, Sun Hanying, Military Commissioner of Jiang Prefecture, died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Sun Hanying, military commissioner of Jiang Prefecture, died.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，荊南奏，湖南亂，大將軍陸孟俊執偽節度使馬希萼遷於衡州，立希萼弟希崇為留後，將吏二千餘人，遇害者半，牙署庫藏焚燒殆盡。

translations.literal: On the xinchou day, Jingnan reported that Hunan was in turmoil: Grand General Lu Mengjun seized the false Military Commissioner Ma Xie and moved him to Heng Prefecture, installing Xie's younger brother Xichong as acting commissioner; of more than two thousand officers and clerks, half were killed, and the headquarters stores were nearly all burned.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Jingnan reported turmoil in Hunan: Grand General Lu Mengjun seized the Southern Chu ruler Ma Xie, removed him to Heng Prefecture, and installed Xie's younger brother Xichong as acting commissioner. Of more than two thousand officials and troops, half were killed, and the headquarters treasury was almost wholly destroyed by fire.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔並吏部三銓為一銓，委本司長官通判。

translations.literal: On the yisi day, an edict ordered the three boards of selection in the Ministry of Personnel merged into one, entrusted to the chief official of that ministry for overall supervision.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, an edict merged the Ministry of Personnel's three selection boards into one, placing overall responsibility with the ministry's chief official.

sentences.zh: 丙午，晉州巡檢王萬敢奏，河東劉崇入寇，營於州北。

translations.literal: On the bingwu day, Jin Prefecture Inspector Wang Wangan reported that Liu Chong of Hedong had invaded and encamped north of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Jin Prefecture inspector Wang Wangan reported that Liu Chong of Hedong had raided the border and pitched camp north of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，潞州奏，河東賊軍寇境。

translations.literal: On the xinhai day, Luzhou reported that Hedong rebel troops were raiding the border.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Luzhou reported Hedong rebel forces raiding the frontier.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，荊南奏，淮南遣鄂州節度使劉仁贍，以戰船二百艘於今月二十五日入岳州。

translations.literal: On the yimao day, Jingnan reported that Huainan had sent E Prefecture Military Commissioner Liu Renshan with two hundred warships, which entered Yue Prefecture on the twenty-fifth of this month.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Jingnan reported that Huainan had dispatched E Prefecture military commissioner Liu Renshan with two hundred warships, which entered Yue Prefecture on the twenty-fifth of that month.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔樞密使王峻率兵援晉州。

translations.literal: On the bingchen day, an edict ordered Privy Council Commissioner Wang Jun to lead troops to relieve Jin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, the emperor ordered Privy Council Commissioner Wang Jun to march to the relief of Jin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以左衛將軍申師厚為河西軍節度使、檢校太保。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day, Left Guard General Shen Shihou was made Military Commissioner of Hexi Army and Honorary Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Left Guard General Shen Shihou was appointed military commissioner of the Hexi army and honorary grand guardian.

sentences.zh: 師厚素與王峻善，及峻貴，師厚羈旅無依，日於峻馬前望塵而拜，會西涼請帥，帝令擇之，無欲去者，峻乃以師厚奏之，師厚亦欣然求往，尋自前鎮將授左衛將軍、檢校工部尚書。

translations.literal: Shihou had long been on good terms with Wang Jun; when Jun rose to high rank, Shihou, adrift without support, daily bowed in the dust before Jun's horse. When Liang requested a commander, the emperor ordered one chosen; no one wished to go, so Jun memorialized Shihou, and Shihou also gladly sought the post. Soon, from his former post as garrison commander, he was appointed Left Guard General and Honorary Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Shihou had long been friendly with Wang Jun. After Jun rose to power, Shihou, stranded without patronage, would bow in the dust before Jun's horse every day. When the Western Liang region requested a military commissioner, the emperor ordered a choice made, but no one wanted the post. Jun therefore recommended Shihou, who eagerly volunteered. Soon afterward he was promoted from garrison commander to Left Guard General and honorary minister of works.

sentences.zh: 翌日，乃有涼州之命，賜旌節、駝馬、繒帛以遣之。

translations.literal: The next day came the appointment to Liang Prefecture; he was granted insignia of command, camels and horses, and silks for his departure.
translations.idiomatic: The following day the Liangzhou appointment came through, and he was sent off with insignia of command, camels, horses, and silks.

sentences.zh: 十一月己未朔，荊南奏，淮南大將邊鎬率兵三萬，自袁州路趨潭州，馬希崇遣從事送牌印，納器仗。

translations.literal: On the jiwei new moon of the eleventh month, Jingnan reported that Huainan's great general Bian Hao led thirty thousand troops from the Yuan Prefecture route toward Tan Prefecture; Ma Xichong sent a staff officer to deliver seals and tallies and surrender weapons and armor.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the eleventh month, jiwei, Jingnan reported that Huainan's chief general Bian Hao was marching thirty thousand men from Yuan Prefecture toward Tan. Ma Xichong sent an aide to deliver his seals of office and surrender his arms.

sentences.zh: 鎬入城，稱武安軍節度使，馬氏諸族及將吏千餘人皆徙於金陵。

translations.literal: Hao entered the city and styled himself Military Commissioner of Wu'an Army; more than a thousand of the Ma clan and their officers and clerks were all relocated to Jinling.
translations.idiomatic: Bian Hao entered the city and took the title of military commissioner of the Wu'an army. More than a thousand members of the Ma clan and their officials were resettled at Jinling.

sentences.zh: 甲子夜，東南白虹亙天。

translations.literal: On the night of the jiazi day, a white rainbow stretched across the sky in the southeast.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of jiazi, a white rainbow arched across the southeastern sky.

sentences.zh: 以新晉州節度使王彥超為晉絳行營馬軍都虞候。

translations.literal: The newly appointed Military Commissioner of Jin Prefecture, Wang Yanchao, was made Chief Controller of Cavalry for the Jin-Jiang campaign headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yanchao, the newly appointed military commissioner of Jin Prefecture, was named chief controller of cavalry for the Jin-Jiang campaign headquarters.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，命王峻出征晉州，帝幸西莊以餞之。

translations.literal: On the yichou day, Wang Jun was ordered to campaign against Jin Prefecture; the emperor went to the Western Villa to give him a farewell feast.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Wang Jun was ordered to take the field against Jin Prefecture, and the emperor went to the Western Villa to see him off.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，日南至，群臣拜表稱賀。

translations.literal: On the jiaxu day, the winter solstice; the officials presented memorials of congratulation.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, the winter solstice, the court officials submitted congratulatory memorials.

sentences.zh: 甲申，葬故貴妃張氏。

translations.literal: On the jiashen day, the late Honored Consort Zhang was buried.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, the late Honored Consort Zhang was interred.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔：「唐朝五廟，舊在至德宮安置，應屬徽陵莊田園舍，宜令新除右監門將軍李重玉為主。

translations.literal: On the dinghai day, an edict said: "The five temples of the Tang dynasty, formerly maintained at Zhide Palace, together with the estates and gardens belonging to Huiling—the newly appointed Right Gate General Li Chongyu should be made custodian.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, an edict declared: "The five Tang ancestral temples, formerly kept at Zhide Palace, along with the estates and gardens attached to Emperor Zhuangzong's mausoleum, shall be placed under the newly appointed Right Gate General Li Chongyu as custodian.

sentences.zh: 其緣陵緣廟法物，除合留外，所有金銀器物，充遷葬故淑妃王氏及許王從益外，其餘並給與重玉及尼惠英、惠燈、惠能、惠嚴等。

translations.literal: Of the ritual objects connected with the mausoleum and temples, apart from what should be retained, all gold and silver vessels—except those needed for reburial of the late Virtuous Consort Wang and Prince Xu Congyi—are to be given to Chongyu and the nuns Huiying, Huideng, Huineng, Huiyan, and others.
translations.idiomatic: Of the ritual objects tied to the mausoleum and temples, everything that need not be kept—all gold and silver vessels except those required to rebury the late Virtuous Consort Wang and Prince Xu Congyi—shall be given to Chongyu and to the nuns Huiying, Huideng, Huineng, Huiyan, and the rest.

sentences.zh: 令重玉以時祀陵廟，務在豐潔。

translations.literal: Chongyu is ordered to sacrifice at the mausoleum and temples on schedule, with offerings to be ample and pure.
translations.idiomatic: Chongyu was charged to perform the scheduled sacrifices at the mausoleum and temples with full and proper offerings.

sentences.zh: 」重玉，故皇城使李從璨之子，明宗之孫，惠英等亦明宗親屬也，故帝授重玉官秩，令主先祀，恤王者之後也。

translations.literal: " Chongyu was the son of the former Director of the Imperial City Li Congcan and a grandson of Emperor Mingzong; Huiying and the others were also Mingzong's kin. Therefore the emperor granted Chongyu rank and ordered him to preside over the former sacrifices—showing compassion for the descendants of kings.
translations.idiomatic: " Chongyu was the son of the former director of the imperial city, Li Congcan, and a grandson of Emperor Mingzong of Tang; Huiying and the other nuns were also Mingzong's kin. The emperor therefore gave Chongyu an official post and put him in charge of the ancestral rites—a gesture of care toward the fallen dynasty's line.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊子朔，詔以劉崇入寇，取當月三日暫幸西京。

translations.literal: On the wuzi new moon of the twelfth month, an edict, because Liu Chong had invaded, set the third day of that month for a temporary visit to the Western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the twelfth month, wuzi, an edict announced that because Liu Chong had invaded, the emperor would make a temporary visit to the Western Capital on the third of the month.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔巡幸宜停。

translations.literal: On the gengyin day, an edict ordered that the tour should be halted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, an edict canceled the planned tour.

sentences.zh: 時王峻駐軍陜府，聞帝西巡，遣使馳奏，不勞車駕順動，帝乃止。

translations.literal: At that time Wang Jun was encamped at Shan Prefecture; hearing that the emperor was touring west, he sent a messenger in haste to report that there was no need for the imperial carriage to move, and the emperor then stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jun was then encamped at Shan Prefecture. When he heard the emperor planned to travel west, he sent an urgent dispatch urging that the imperial progress was unnecessary, and the emperor called off the journey.

sentences.zh: 乙未，幸西莊。

translations.literal: On the yiwei day, the emperor visited the Western Villa.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, the emperor visited the Western Villa.

sentences.zh: 兗州慕容彥超上言，乞朝覲，詔允之，尋稱部內草寇起，不敢離鎮。

translations.literal: Murong Yanchao of Yan Prefecture submitted a memorial requesting an audience; an edict approved it, but soon he claimed that bandits had risen within his jurisdiction and he dared not leave his post.
translations.idiomatic: Murong Yanchao of Yan Prefecture asked permission to come to court; the emperor assented, but Yanchao soon claimed that bandits had broken out in his territory and that he dared not leave his post.

sentences.zh: 戊申，鄆州奏，慕容彥超據城反。

translations.literal: On the wushen day, Yan Prefecture reported that Murong Yanchao had seized the city and rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Yan Prefecture reported that Murong Yanchao had rebelled and seized the city.

sentences.zh: 己酉，王峻奏，劉崇逃遁，王師已入晉州。

translations.literal: On the jiyou day, Wang Jun reported that Liu Chong had fled and the imperial army had entered Jin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Wang Jun reported that Liu Chong had fled and the imperial forces had taken Jin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: （《宋史·陳思讓傳》：王峻援晉州，以思讓與康延昭分為左右廂排陣使，令率軍自烏嶺路至絳州，與大軍合。

translations.literal: (Song History, Biography of Chen Siyang: When Wang Jun relieved Jin Prefecture, he made Siyang and Kang Yanzhao left and right wing array marshals, ordering them to lead troops from the Wuling route to Jiang Prefecture to join the main force.
translations.idiomatic: (According to the Song History, Biography of Chen Siyang: When Wang Jun marched to relieve Jin Prefecture, he appointed Siyang and Kang Yanzhao marshals of the left and right wings and ordered them to advance from the Wuling route to Jiang Prefecture to join the main army.

sentences.zh: 崇燒營遁去，思讓又與藥元福襲破之。）〉

translations.literal: Chong burned his camp and fled; Siyang again joined with Yao Yuanfu to strike and defeat him.)]
translations.idiomatic: Chong burned his camp and fled; Siyang then joined Yao Yuanfu in a surprise attack that routed him.)]

sentences.zh: 廣順二年春正月戊午朔，不受朝賀，以宿兵在外故也。

translations.literal: On the wuwu new moon of the first month of spring in the second year of Guangshun, court congratulations were not received, because troops were still in the field.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the first month of spring in the second year of Guangshun, wuwu, the court declined the usual New Year congratulations because troops were still on campaign.

sentences.zh: 庚申，王峻奏，起近鎮丁夫二萬城晉州。

translations.literal: On the gengshen day, Wang Jun reported that twenty thousand corvée laborers from nearby garrisons had been levied to fortify Jin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Wang Jun reported that twenty thousand laborers from nearby garrisons had been drafted to rebuild Jin Prefecture's walls.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，修東京羅城，凡役丁夫五萬五千，兩旬而罷。

translations.literal: On the renxu day, the outer wall of the Eastern Capital was repaired; in all fifty-five thousand corvée laborers were employed, and the work was completed in twenty days.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, repairs began on the outer wall of the Eastern Capital. Fifty-five thousand laborers were conscripted, and the work was finished in twenty days.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以侍衛步軍都指揮使曹英為兗州行營都部署，以齊州防禦使史延韜為副部署，以皇城使向訓為兵馬都監，陳州防禦使藥元福為馬步都虞候，率兵討慕容彥超。

translations.literal: On the jiazi day, Palace Guard Infantry Commander Cao Ying was made overall commander of the Yan Prefecture campaign headquarters; Qi Prefecture Defense Commissioner Shi Yantao was made deputy commander; Imperial City Commissioner Xiang Xun was made overall supervisor of troops and horses; Chen Prefecture Defense Commissioner Yao Yuanfu was made chief controller of horse and foot; they led troops to attack Murong Yanchao.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Palace Guard infantry commander Cao Ying was appointed overall commander of the Yanzhou campaign; Qi Prefecture defense commissioner Shi Yantao became his deputy; imperial city commissioner Xiang Xun was named supervisor of troops and horses; and Chen Prefecture defense commissioner Yao Yuanfu was made chief controller of cavalry and infantry. They marched to suppress Murong Yanchao.

sentences.zh: （《隆平集》：慕容彥超盜據兗、海，周祖命曹英為帥，向訓副之，參用藥元福以兵從。

translations.literal: (Longping Collection: Murong Yanchao seized Yan and Hai by force; the Zhou founder appointed Cao Ying commander, with Xiang Xun as deputy, and employed Yao Yuanfu with troops in support.
translations.idiomatic: (According to the Longping Collection: Murong Yanchao had seized Yan and Hai by force. The Zhou founder appointed Cao Ying commander, with Xiang Xun as his deputy, and brought Yao Yuanfu along with the army.

sentences.zh: 謂元福曰：「已敕英、訓，勿以軍禮見汝。

translations.literal: He said to Yuanfu: "I have already ordered Ying and Xun not to receive you with military ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: He told Yuanfu, "I have already instructed Ying and Xun not to treat you with military deference.

sentences.zh: 」及元福至，英、訓皆父事焉。）〉

translations.literal: " When Yuanfu arrived, both Ying and Xun treated him as a father.)]
translations.idiomatic: " When Yuanfu arrived, however, both Ying and Xun treated him with the respect due a father.)]

sentences.zh: 諸軍入兗州界，不得下路停止村舍，犯者以軍法從事。

translations.literal: When the armies entered Yan Prefecture territory, they were forbidden to leave the road and halt in villages or houses; violators were dealt with by military law.
translations.idiomatic: As the armies entered Yan Prefecture, they were forbidden to leave the main road or billet in villages; offenders were punished under military law.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，徐州巡檢供給官張令彬奏，破淮賊於沭陽，斬首千餘級，擒賊將燕敬權。

translations.literal: On the bingyin day, Xuzhou Inspector and Supply Officer Zhang Lingbin reported defeating Huai rebels at Shuyang, beheading more than a thousand, and capturing the rebel general Yan Jingquan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Xuzhou inspector and supply officer Zhang Lingbin reported a victory over Huainan forces at Shuyang: more than a thousand heads taken and the rebel general Yan Jingquan captured.

sentences.zh: 時慕容彥超求援於淮南，淮南偽主李景發兵援之，師於下邳，聞官軍至，退趨沭陽，遂破之。

translations.literal: At that time Murong Yanchao had sought aid from Huainan; the false ruler of Huainan, Li Jing, sent troops to support him, encamped at Xiapi, and on hearing that the imperial army had arrived, withdrew toward Shuyang and was there defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Murong Yanchao had asked Southern Tang for help, and Li Jing of Huainan sent reinforcements, encamping at Xiapi. When they learned the imperial army was coming, they fell back toward Shuyang and were defeated there.

sentences.zh: 庚午，高麗權知國事王昭遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: On the gengwu day, Wang Zhao, acting administrator of Goryeo affairs, sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Wang Zhao, who was acting as regent of Goryeo, sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 壬申，鎮州何福進差人部送先擒獲到河東賊軍二百餘人至闕下，詔給巾履衫袴以釋之。

translations.literal: On the renshen day, He Fujin of Zhen Prefecture dispatched men escorting more than two hundred Hedong rebel soldiers previously captured to the capital; an edict ordered headcloths, shoes, gowns, and trousers given them and they were released.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, He Fujin of Zhen Prefecture sent to the capital more than two hundred captured Hedong soldiers. The emperor ordered them given clothing and footwear and released.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，徐州部送沭陽所獲賊將燕敬權等四人至闕下，詔賜衣服金帛，放歸本土，敬權等感泣謝罪。

translations.literal: On the wuyin day, Xuzhou escorted to the capital the four rebel generals captured at Shuyang, including Yan Jingquan; an edict granted them clothing and gold silks and sent them home; Jingquan and the others wept in gratitude and begged forgiveness.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Xuzhou delivered to court the four enemy officers captured at Shuyang, including Yan Jingquan. The emperor gave them clothing and gold silks and sent them home. Jingquan and his companions wept as they thanked him for their lives.

sentences.zh: 帝召見謂之曰：「夫惡兇邪，獎忠順，天下一也。

translations.literal: The emperor summoned them and said: "To hate the vicious and evil and reward the loyal and obedient is one principle throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor received them and said, "To condemn wickedness and reward loyalty is a single principle throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 我之賊臣，撓亂國法，嬰城作逆，殃及生靈，不意吳人助茲兇惡，非良算也，爾當歸言之於爾君。

translations.literal: My rebel subject has disturbed the laws of the state, held the city and risen in revolt, and brought calamity on the people. I did not expect the Wu people to aid this villainy—it is no good plan. You should return and report this to your lord.
translations.idiomatic: My own rebel has defied the law, walled himself in, and brought suffering on the people. I did not expect the Wu court to aid such villainy—that was no wise policy. Go home and tell your sovereign what I have said.

sentences.zh: 」初，漢末遣三司軍將路昌祚於湖南市茶，屬淮南將邊鎬陷長沙，昌祚被賊送金陵。

translations.literal: " Earlier, at the end of Han, the court had sent Revenue Bureau army officer Lu Changzuo to Hunan to purchase tea; when Huainan general Bian Hao captured Changsha, Changzuo was taken by the rebels to Jinling.
translations.idiomatic: " Earlier, near the end of the Later Han dynasty, the court had sent Revenue Bureau officer Lu Changzuo to Hunan to buy tea. When Huainan's Bian Hao took Changsha, Changzuo was carried off to Jinling as a captive.

sentences.zh: 及敬權自大朝歸，具以帝言告於李景，景乃召昌祚，延坐從容久之，且稱美大朝皇帝聖德廣被，恩沾鄰土，深有依附國家之意。

translations.literal: When Jingquan returned from the Great Court, he fully reported the emperor's words to Li Jing; Jing then summoned Changzuo, seated him at ease for a long while, and praised the Great Court emperor's sagely virtue spreading widely, his grace reaching neighboring lands, and his deep intent to draw the state close.
translations.idiomatic: When Jingquan returned from the Zhou court, he repeated the emperor's message to Li Jing. Jing summoned Changzuo, received him at length with courtesy, and spoke admiringly of the Zhou emperor's far-reaching virtue, his kindness toward neighboring lands, and his wish to draw their states closer.

sentences.zh: 及罷，遣偽宰相宋齊丘宴昌祚於別館，又令訪昌祚在湖南遭變之時，亡失綱運之數，命依數償之，給茗荈萬八千斤，遣水運至江夏，仍厚給行裝，遣之歸闕。

translations.literal: When the audience ended, he sent his false chancellor Song Qiqiu to feast Changzuo at a separate lodge, and also ordered inquiry into how much tax transport Changzuo had lost when disaster struck in Hunan; he commanded repayment according to the amount, gave eighteen thousand jin of tea, dispatched it by water transport to Jiangxia, and still generously provided traveling gear and sent him back to court.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward he had his chancellor Song Qiqiu entertain Changzuo at a guest lodge and inquired how much tax tea had been lost when disaster struck in Hunan. Jing ordered full compensation, presented eighteen thousand jin of tea, shipped it by water to Jiangxia, furnished generous traveling expenses, and sent Changzuo back to the Zhou capital.

sentences.zh: 二月庚寅，府州防卸使折德扆奏，河東賊軍寇境，率州兵破之，斬首二千級。

translations.literal: On the gengyin day of the second month, Fu Prefecture Defense Commissioner Zhe Deyi reported that Hedong rebel troops had raided the border; he led prefectural troops to defeat them and took two thousand heads.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin in the second month, Fu Prefecture defense commissioner Zhe Deyi reported a Hedong raid on his border. He led the prefectural troops to victory and took two thousand heads.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，太白經天。

translations.literal: On the xinmao day, Venus crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Venus crossed the heavens.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以權知高麗國事王昭為高麗國王。

translations.literal: On the guisi day, Wang Zhao, acting administrator of Goryeo affairs, was made King of Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Wang Zhao, who had been acting regent of Goryeo, was recognized as king of Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 庚子，府州防卸使折德扆奏，收河東界岢嵐軍。

translations.literal: On the gengzi day, Fu Prefecture Defense Commissioner Zhe Deyi reported the recovery of Kelan Garrison on the Hedong border.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Zhe Deyi reported the recapture of Kelan Garrison on the Hedong frontier.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，詔先獲河東鄉軍一百餘人，各給錢鞋放歸鄉里。

translations.literal: On the guimao day, an edict ordered that the more than one hundred Hedong local soldiers previously captured each be given money and shoes and released to their home districts.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, an edict ordered that the more than one hundred captured Hedong militiamen be given money and shoes and sent home.

sentences.zh: 壬子，太子太師致仕安審暉卒。

translations.literal: On the renzi day, Retired Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent An Shenhui died.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, An Shenhui, retired grand preceptor of the heir apparent, died.

sentences.zh: 三月庚申，幸南莊，令從臣習射。

translations.literal: On the gengshen day of the third month, the emperor visited the Southern Villa and ordered his attending ministers to practice archery.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen in the third month, the emperor visited the Southern Villa and had his attendants practice archery.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以樞密院直學士、左諫議大夫王溥為中書舍人，充翰林學士；

translations.literal: On the wuchen day, Privy Council Academician and Left Reminder Wang Pu was made Drafting Secretary in the Secretariat and appointed Hanlin Academician;
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Privy Council academician and Left Reminder Wang Pu was appointed drafting secretary in the Secretariat and Hanlin academician;

sentences.zh: 以內客省使、恩州團練使鄭仁誨為樞密副使。

translations.literal: Inner Palace Service Commissioner and En Prefecture Militia Commissioner Zheng Renhui was made Vice Commissioner of the Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: and Inner Palace Service commissioner and En Prefecture militia commissioner Zheng Renhui was made vice commissioner of the Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 詔宣徽北院使翟光鄴權知永興軍府事。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Northern Bureau Commissioner of the Palace Secretariat Zhai Guangye to serve as acting administrator of Yongxing Military Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: An edict named Northern Bureau commissioner of the Palace Secretariat Zhai Guangye acting administrator of Yongxing.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，回鶻遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: On the jiaxu day, the Uyghurs sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Uyghur envoys arrived with tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔：「西京莊宅司、內侍省、宮苑司、內園等四司，所管諸巡系稅戶二千五百並還府縣。

translations.literal: On the gengchen day, an edict said: "The Western Capital Estates Office, Inner Palace Service, Palace Parks Office, Inner Gardens, and the other four offices—the twenty-five hundred tax households under their various patrol jurisdictions are all to be returned to the prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, an edict declared: "The twenty-five hundred tax households administered by the Western Capital Estates Office, the Inner Palace Service, the Palace Parks Office, the Inner Gardens, and related agencies shall all be returned to their prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 其廣德、升平二宮並停廢。

translations.literal: The Guangde and Shengping palaces are both to be discontinued.
translations.idiomatic: The Guangde and Shengping palaces are to be abolished.

sentences.zh: 應行從諸莊園林、亭殿、房舍、什物課利，宜令逐司依舊收管。」

translations.literal: Revenues from estates, gardens, pavilions, halls, houses, and goods used for imperial processions should be ordered collected as before by each office in turn."
translations.idiomatic: Revenues from the estates, gardens, pavilions, halls, houses, and goods used for imperial processions shall continue to be collected by the respective offices as before."

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙戌朔，日有食之，帝避正殿，百官守司。

translations.literal: On the bingxu new moon of the fourth month of summer, there was a solar eclipse; the emperor avoided the main hall and the officials remained at their posts.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the fourth month of summer, bingxu, a solar eclipse occurred. The emperor left the main hall, and the officials remained at their duties.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔停蔡州鄉軍。

translations.literal: On the dinghai day, an edict ordered the disbandment of Cai Prefecture local troops.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, an edict disbanded the local militia of Cai Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以京師旱，分命群臣禱雨。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day, because the capital was afflicted by drought, various ministers were separately ordered to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, because drought had struck the capital, the emperor dispatched various ministers to pray for rain.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，制削奪慕容彥超在身官爵。

translations.literal: On the guisi day, a decree stripped Murong Yanchao of his current ranks and titles.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, a decree stripped Murong Yanchao of all his ranks and titles.

sentences.zh: 甲午，高麗國冊使、衛尉卿劉皞卒。

translations.literal: On the jiawu day, Liu Hao, envoy investing the King of Goryeo and Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Liu Hao, who had been envoy for the investiture of the king of Goryeo and director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, died.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔取來月五日，車駕赴兗州城下，慰勞將士。

translations.literal: On the yimao day, an edict set the fifth day of the coming month for the imperial carriage to go to the walls of Yan Prefecture to comfort the troops.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, an edict scheduled the fifth of the following month for the emperor to go to Yanzhou to encourage the troops under the city walls.

sentences.zh: 以樞密副使鄭仁誨為右衛大將軍，依前充職，兼權大內都點檢；

translations.literal: Privy Council Vice Commissioner Zheng Renhui was made General of the Right Guards, continuing in his former post, and concurrently acting Chief Inspector of the Inner Palace;
translations.idiomatic: Privy Council vice commissioner Zheng Renhui was appointed general of the Right Guards while retaining his former post, and was also made acting chief inspector of the inner palace;

sentences.zh: 以中書侍郎、平章事、判三司李穀為權東京留守，兼判開封府事。

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Secretariat, Grand Councilor, and Commissioner of the Revenue Bureau Li Gu was made acting Eastern Capital Regent and concurrently commissioner of Kaifeng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: and Vice Director of the Secretariat, grand councilor, and commissioner of the Revenue Bureau Li Gu was named acting regent of the Eastern Capital and commissioner of Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 五月丙辰朔，帝御崇元殿受朝，仗衛如儀。

translations.literal: On the bingchen new moon of the fifth month, the emperor took the throne in Chongyuan Hall to receive court, with guards and insignia according to ritual.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the fifth month, bingchen, the emperor held court in Chongyuan Hall with full ceremonial guard.

sentences.zh: 庚申，車駕發京師。

translations.literal: On the gengshen day, the imperial carriage departed the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, the emperor left the capital.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，至兗州城下。

translations.literal: On the wuchen day, he arrived below the walls of Yan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, he reached Yanzhou and camped below the city walls.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，收復兗州，斬慕容彥超，夷其族。

translations.literal: On the yihai day, Yan Prefecture was recovered; Murong Yanchao was beheaded and his clan exterminated.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Yanzhou was recovered. Murong Yanchao was executed and his entire clan wiped out.

sentences.zh: 詔端明殿學士顏衎權知兗州軍州事。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Duanming Hall Academician Yan Yan to serve as acting administrator of Yan Prefecture military and civil affairs.
translations.idiomatic: An edict appointed Duanming Hall academician Yan Yan acting administrator of Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬午，曲赦兗州管內罪人，取五月二十七日已前所犯罪，大辟已下，咸赦除之。

translations.literal: On the renwu day, a partial amnesty was proclaimed for criminals within Yan Prefecture jurisdiction; crimes committed before the twenty-seventh day of the fifth month, from capital offenses down, were all pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, a partial amnesty was granted to criminals in Yanzhou: all offenses committed before the twenty-seventh of the fifth month, down to capital crimes, were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 慕容彥超徒黨，有逃避潛竄者，及城內將吏等並放罪。

translations.literal: Followers of Murong Yanchao who had fled and hidden, as well as officers and clerks within the city, were all released from guilt.
translations.idiomatic: Followers of Murong Yanchao who had fled into hiding, along with the city's officers and clerks, were all pardoned.

sentences.zh: 自慕容彥超違背以來，鄉州內有接便為非者，一切不問。

translations.literal: Since Murong Yanchao's rebellion, anyone in the prefecture who had taken advantage to do wrong was not questioned at all.
translations.idiomatic: Anyone in the prefecture who had taken advantage of the rebellion to commit wrongdoing was likewise not prosecuted.

sentences.zh: 諸軍將士歿於王事者，各與賻贈，都頭已上與贈官。

translations.literal: Officers and soldiers of the armies who died in the king's service each received funeral gifts; those of company head rank and above also received posthumous offices.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers who had died in the imperial service were granted funeral gifts, and those of company-head rank and above received posthumous offices.

sentences.zh: 兗州城內及官軍下寨四面去州五里內，今年所征夏秋稅及沿征錢物並放；

translations.literal: Within Yan Prefecture city and within five li on all sides of the imperial army camps, this year's summer and autumn taxes and all levied monies were remitted;
translations.idiomatic: Within Yanzhou city and within five li of the army camps on every side, that year's summer and autumn taxes and all supplementary levies were remitted;

sentences.zh: 十里內，只放夏稅；

translations.literal: within ten li, only the summer tax was remitted;
translations.idiomatic: within ten li, only the summer tax was remitted;

sentences.zh: 一州管界，今夏苗子三分放一分。

translations.literal: throughout the prefecture's jurisdiction, one-third of this summer's seedling tax was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: and throughout the entire prefecture, one-third of the summer seedling tax was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 城內百姓遭毀拆舍屋及遭燒焚者，給賜材木。

translations.literal: Commoners within the city whose houses had been destroyed or burned were given timber as gifts.
translations.idiomatic: City residents whose homes had been torn down or burned were given lumber to rebuild.

sentences.zh: 諸處差到人夫內，有遭矢石死者，各給絹三匹，仍放戶下三年徭役雲。

translations.literal: Among corvée laborers dispatched from various places, those killed by arrows and stones each received three bolts of silk, and their households were exempted from corvée for three years.
translations.idiomatic: Among the laborers conscripted from various districts, families of those killed by missiles were given three bolts of silk each, and their households were exempted from corvée labor for three years.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔兗州降為防禦州，仍為望州。

translations.literal: On the guiwei day, an edict reduced Yan Prefecture to a defense prefecture, while it remained a prestigious prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, an edict reduced Yanzhou from a military commission to a defense prefecture, though it retained its status as a prestigious prefecture.

sentences.zh: 六月乙酉朔，帝幸曲阜縣，謁孔子祠。

translations.literal: On the yiyou new moon of the sixth month, the emperor visited Qufu County and paid respects at the temple of Confucius.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the sixth month, yiyou, the emperor visited Qufu County and paid his respects at the temple of Confucius.

sentences.zh: 既奠，將致拜，左右曰：「仲尼，人臣也，無致拜。

translations.literal: After the offering, as he was about to perform a full bow, those at his side said: "Zhongni was a subject; there should be no full bow.
translations.idiomatic: After the offering, as he was about to perform a full prostration, his attendants said, "Confucius was only a subject—Your Majesty should not bow fully.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「文宣王，百代帝王師也，得無敬乎！

translations.literal: " The emperor said: "The Cultured and Exalted King was teacher to emperors and kings for a hundred generations—how could one not show respect!
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor replied, "The Cultured and Exalted King was teacher to rulers for a hundred generations—how could I fail to show him respect!

sentences.zh: 」即拜奠於祠前。

translations.literal: " He then bowed and made offering before the temple.
translations.idiomatic: " He then performed a full bow and offering before the shrine.

sentences.zh: 其所奠酒器、銀爐並留於祠所。

translations.literal: The wine vessels and silver censers used in the offering were all left at the shrine.
translations.idiomatic: The wine vessels and silver censers used in the offering were left at the shrine.

sentences.zh: 遂幸孔林，拜孔子墓。

translations.literal: He then visited the Kong Forest and bowed at Confucius's tomb.
translations.idiomatic: He then visited the Kong family grove and paid his respects at Confucius's tomb.

sentences.zh: 帝謂近臣曰：「仲尼、亞聖之後，今有何人？

translations.literal: The emperor said to his close ministers: "Among the descendants of Zhongni and the Second Sage, who are there now?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor asked his close advisers, "Who survives today among the descendants of Confucius and Yan Hui?

sentences.zh: 」對曰：「前曲阜令、襲文宣公孔仁玉，是仲尼四十三代孫；

translations.literal: " They replied: "The former magistrate of Qufu, hereditary Duke of Cultured Exaltation Kong Renyu, is the forty-third-generation descendant of Zhongni;
translations.idiomatic: " They answered, "The former magistrate of Qufu, hereditary Duke of Cultured Exaltation Kong Renyu, is Confucius's forty-third-generation descendant;

sentences.zh: 有鄉貢《三禮》顏涉，是顏淵之後。

translations.literal: there is Yan She, a local candidate in the Three Rites, who is a descendant of Yan Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: and Yan She, a local candidate in the Three Rites, is a descendant of Yan Hui.

sentences.zh: 」即召見。

translations.literal: " They were immediately summoned for audience.
translations.idiomatic: " Both were summoned at once.

sentences.zh: 仁玉賜緋，口授曲阜令，顏涉授主簿，便令視事。

translations.literal: Renyu was granted crimson robes and orally appointed magistrate of Qufu; Yan She was appointed registrar and ordered to take up his duties at once.
translations.idiomatic: Renyu was given crimson robes and orally appointed magistrate of Qufu; Yan She was made registrar and ordered to take up office immediately.

sentences.zh: 仍敕兗州修葺孔子祠宇，墓側禁樵采。

translations.literal: Yan Prefecture was also ordered to repair the temple of Confucius, and cutting wood or gathering fuel beside the tomb was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Yanzhou was also ordered to repair the temple of Confucius, and cutting timber or gathering fuel beside the tomb was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，車駕還京。

translations.literal: On the bingxu day, the imperial carriage returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, the emperor returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 初，帝以五月十三日至兗州，賊尚拒守，至十七日，晝夢道士一人進書，卷首云「車駕來月二日還京」，其下文字絕多，不能盡記。

translations.literal: Earlier, the emperor had arrived at Yan Prefecture on the thirteenth day of the fifth month while the rebels still held out; on the seventeenth, by day he dreamed that a Daoist presented a book whose opening read "The imperial carriage will return to the capital on the second of next month"; the text below was extremely long and could not all be remembered.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor had reached Yanzhou on the thirteenth of the fifth month, the rebels were still holding the city. On the seventeenth he dreamed by day that a Daoist presented a scroll whose opening line read, "The imperial carriage will return to the capital on the second of next month." The rest was too long to remember in full.

sentences.zh: 既寤，以夢告宰臣，又四日而城拔。

translations.literal: When he awoke, he told the dream to his chief ministers; four days later the city fell.
translations.idiomatic: On waking he told his chief ministers the dream, and four days later the city fell.

sentences.zh: 帝至軍，凡駐蹕九日而賊平，果以六月二日發離城下，近代親征克捷，無如此之速也。

translations.literal: From the emperor's arrival at the army until the rebels were pacified, he halted in all nine days; he indeed departed below the walls on the second day of the sixth month—among personal campaigns of recent times that achieved victory, none was so swift as this.
translations.idiomatic: From the emperor's arrival at the army until the rebels were crushed, only nine days passed. He left the city on the second of the sixth month, exactly as the dream had foretold—no imperial campaign in recent memory had achieved victory so quickly.

sentences.zh: 是日大雨，城下行宮，水深數尺。

translations.literal: That day there was heavy rain; at the traveling palace below the city, the water was several feet deep.
translations.idiomatic: That day brought heavy rain, and the water rose several feet around the temporary palace below the walls.

sentences.zh: 其日晚，至中都縣，帝笑謂侍臣曰：「今日若不離城下，則當為潦所溺矣。

translations.literal: That evening he reached Zhongdu County; the emperor smiled and said to his attendants: "Had we not left below the walls today, we would have been drowned by the flood.
translations.idiomatic: That evening he reached Zhongdu County and said with a smile to his attendants, "If we had not left the city today, we would have been drowned in the flood.

sentences.zh: 」戊戌，車駕至自兗州。

translations.literal: " On the wuxu day, the imperial carriage returned from Yan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: " On wuxu, the emperor returned from Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以靈武節度使馮暉卒，輟視朝一日。

translations.literal: On the xinchou day, because Lingwu Military Commissioner Feng Hui had died, court audiences were suspended for one day.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, court audiences were suspended for one day upon the death of Lingwu military commissioner Feng Hui.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，前翰林學士李澣自契丹中上表，陳奏機事，且言偽幽州節度使蕭海貞欲謀向化，帝甚嘉之。

translations.literal: On the renyin day, former Hanlin Academician Li Huan submitted a memorial from within the Khitan lands, reporting on strategic affairs and stating that the false Military Commissioner of You Prefecture, Xiao Haizhen, wished to plot defection to the court; the emperor greatly praised this.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, former Hanlin academician Li Huan sent a memorial from Khitan territory reporting on strategic affairs and claiming that the Liao military commissioner of Youzhou, Xiao Haizhen, wished to defect. The emperor was greatly pleased.

sentences.zh: （《宋史·李澣傳》：海貞與澣相善，澣乘間諷海貞以南歸之計，海貞納之。

translations.literal: (Song History, Biography of Li Huan: Haizhen was on good terms with Huan; Huan seized an opportunity to suggest to Haizhen a plan to return south, and Haizhen accepted it.
translations.idiomatic: (According to the Song History, Biography of Li Huan: Haizhen and Huan were on friendly terms. Huan took the opportunity to urge Haizhen to return to the south, and Haizhen agreed.

sentences.zh: 周廣順二年，澣因定州孫方諫密表，言契丹衰微之勢，周祖嘉焉，遣諜者田重霸賫詔慰撫，仍命浣通信。

translations.literal: In the second year of Guangshun of Zhou, Huan through Ding Prefecture's Sun Fangjian sent a secret memorial describing the Khitan decline; the Zhou founder was pleased and dispatched the agent Tian Chongba bearing an edict of reassurance, and also ordered Huan to maintain correspondence.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Guangshun, Huan sent a secret memorial through Sun Fangjian of Ding Prefecture describing Khitan weakness. The Zhou founder approved and sent the agent Tian Chongba with an edict of reassurance, ordering Huan to keep up communications.

sentences.zh: 澣復表述：「契丹主幼弱多寵，好擊鞠，大臣離貳，若出師討伐，因與通好，乃其時也。

translations.literal: Huan again stated in a memorial: "The Khitan ruler is young and weak, much favored by women, fond of cuju; the great ministers are divided. If troops are sent to attack and friendship is offered at the same time, this is the moment."
translations.idiomatic: Huan wrote again: "The Khitan ruler is young and weak, much indulged by his favorites, and fond of polo; his ministers are divided. If we march against him while offering friendship, the moment is ripe."

sentences.zh: 」屬中原多故，不能用其言。）〉

translations.literal: " But because the Central Plains had many troubles, his advice could not be adopted.)]
translations.idiomatic: " But turmoil in the Central Plains prevented the court from acting on his advice.)]

sentences.zh: 癸卯，德妃董氏薨。

translations.literal: On the guimao day, Virtuous Consort Lady Dong died.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Virtuous Consort Lady Dong died.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔宣徽南院使袁鳷判開封府事。

translations.literal: On the yisi day, an edict ordered Southern Bureau Commissioner of the Palace Secretariat Yuan Zhi to serve as commissioner of Kaifeng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, an edict appointed Southern Bureau commissioner Yuan Zhi to administer Kaifeng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以朔方軍衙內都虞候馮繼業起復為朔方軍兵馬留後。

translations.literal: On the xinhai day, Feng Jiye, Chief Controller in the Shuo Fang Army headquarters, was recalled from mourning to serve as acting commander of Shuo Fang Army troops and horses.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Feng Jiye, chief controller in the Shuofang army headquarters, was recalled from mourning and appointed acting commander of Shuofang forces.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，幸舊宅，為德妃舉哀故也。

translations.literal: On the jiayin day, the emperor visited his old residence because of mourning for the Virtuous Consort.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, the emperor visited his old residence to mourn the Virtuous Consort.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙辰，詔：「內外臣僚，每遇永壽節，舊設齋供。

translations.literal: On the bingchen day of the seventh month of autumn, an edict said: "Civil and military officials within and without, whenever the Eternal Longevity Festival occurs, formerly set up vegetarian offerings.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen in the seventh month of autumn, an edict declared: "Whenever the Eternal Longevity Festival arrives, officials inside and outside the court have customarily held vegetarian feasts.

sentences.zh: 今後中書門下與文武百官共設一齋，侍衛親軍都指揮使已下共設一齋，樞密使、內諸司使已下共設一齋，其餘前任職員及諸司職掌，更不得開設道場及設齋。

translations.literal: Henceforth the Secretariat-Chancellery and civil and military officials shall jointly hold one feast; the Palace Guard commanders and below shall jointly hold one feast; the Privy Council commissioners and inner palace commissioners and below shall jointly hold one feast; all other former officeholders and agency functionaries are no longer permitted to open ritual sites or hold feasts.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth the Secretariat and all civil and military officials shall hold one shared feast; the palace guard commanders and their subordinates one feast; the privy council commissioners and inner palace commissioners one feast. All other former officials and agency staff are forbidden to open ritual sites or hold separate feasts.

sentences.zh: 」是日大風雨，破屋拔樹，尚書省都堂有龍穿屋壞獸角而去，西壁有爪跡存焉。

translations.literal: " That day there was a great wind and rain; houses were wrecked and trees uprooted. In the main hall of the Ministry of Revenue a dragon pierced the roof, broke the beast-horn ornament, and departed; claw marks remained on the west wall.
translations.idiomatic: " That same day brought violent wind and rain that wrecked houses and uprooted trees. At the Ministry of Revenue a dragon was said to have burst through the roof, broken a roof ornament, and departed, leaving claw marks on the west wall.

sentences.zh: 襄州大水。

translations.literal: Xiang Prefecture suffered great flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang Prefecture was struck by severe flooding.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔復升陳州、曹州為節鎮。

translations.literal: On the dingmao day, an edict restored Chen Prefecture and Cao Prefecture to military commission status.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, an edict restored Chenzhou and Caozhou to full military commission status.

sentences.zh: 以侍衛馬軍都指揮使、洋州節度使郭崇為陳州節度使，以侍衛步軍都指揮使曹英為曹州節度使，並典軍如故。

translations.literal: Palace Guard Cavalry Commander and Yang Prefecture Military Commissioner Guo Chong was made Military Commissioner of Chen Prefecture; Palace Guard Infantry Commander Cao Ying was made Military Commissioner of Cao Prefecture; both continued to command their armies as before.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Guard cavalry commander and Yangzhou military commissioner Guo Chong was appointed military commissioner of Chenzhou; infantry commander Cao Ying was appointed military commissioner of Caozhou; both retained command of their armies.

sentences.zh: 以陳州防禦使藥元福為晉州節度使。

translations.literal: Chen Prefecture Defense Commissioner Yao Yuanfu was made Military Commissioner of Jin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Chenzhou defense commissioner Yao Yuanfu was appointed military commissioner of Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛未，詔相州節度使李筠權知潞州軍州事。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day, an edict ordered Xiang Prefecture Military Commissioner Li Yun to serve as acting administrator of Luzhou military and civil affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, an edict named Xiangzhou military commissioner Li Yun acting administrator of Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以小底都指揮使、漢州刺史李重進為大內都點檢兼馬步都軍頭，領恩州團練使；

translations.literal: On the bingzi day, Lower Palace Guard Commander and Han Prefecture Prefect Li Chongjin was made Chief Inspector of the Inner Palace and concurrently Commander of All Horse and Foot, while retaining his post as En Prefecture Militia Commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Lower Palace Guard commander and Han Prefecture prefect Li Chongjin was appointed chief inspector of the inner palace and commander of all horse and foot troops, while retaining his post as En Prefecture militia commissioner;

sentences.zh: 以內殿直都知、駙馬都尉張永德領和州刺史，充小底第一軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: Inner Palace Direct Guard Director and Imperial Son-in-Law Commandant Zhang Yongde was made Prefect of He Prefecture and appointed Commander of the First Lower Palace Guard Army.
translations.idiomatic: and Inner Palace Direct Guard director and imperial son-in-law Zhang Yongde was made prefect of He Prefecture and commander of the First Lower Palace Guard Army.

sentences.zh: 八月甲申朔，翰林學士、刑部尚書張沆落職守本官。

translations.literal: On the jiashen new moon of the eighth month, Hanlin Academician and Minister of Justice Zhang Hong was removed from office and retained only his original post.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the eighth month, jiashen, Hanlin academician and minister of justice Zhang Hong was stripped of his extra duties and retained only his base rank.

sentences.zh: 以中書舍人、史館修撰判館事徐臺符為禮部尚書，充翰林學士承旨；

translations.literal: Drafting Secretary in the Secretariat and Historiography Compiler directing the Historiography Office Xu Taifu was made Minister of Rites and appointed Chief Hanlin Academician;
translations.idiomatic: Drafting secretary Xu Taifu, who directed the Historiography Office, was appointed minister of rites and chief Hanlin academician;

sentences.zh: 以兵部侍郎韋勛為尚書右丞；

translations.literal: Vice Minister of War Wei Xun was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs;
translations.idiomatic: vice minister of war Wei Xun was made right vice director of the Department of State Affairs;

sentences.zh: 以尚書右丞於德辰為吏部侍郎；

translations.literal: Right Vice Director Yu Dechen was made Vice Minister of Personnel;
translations.idiomatic: right vice director Yu Dechen was made vice minister of personnel;

sentences.zh: 以戶部侍郎邊歸讜為兵部侍郎；

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Revenue Bian Guidang was made Vice Minister of War;
translations.idiomatic: vice minister of revenue Bian Guidang was made vice minister of war;

sentences.zh: 以禮部侍郎趙上交為戶部侍郎；

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Rites Zhao Shangjiao was made Vice Minister of Revenue;
translations.idiomatic: vice minister of rites Zhao Shangjiao was made vice minister of revenue;

sentences.zh: 以樞密直學士、左散騎常侍陳觀為工部侍郎，依前充職；

translations.literal: Privy Council Academician and Left Honorary Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary Chen Guan was made Vice Minister of Works, continuing in his former post;
translations.idiomatic: privy council academician Chen Guan was made vice minister of works while retaining his former post;

sentences.zh: 以刑部侍郎景範為左司郎中，充樞密直學士。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Justice Jing Fan was made Left Bureau Director and appointed Privy Council Academician.
translations.idiomatic: and vice minister of justice Jing Fan was made left bureau director and privy council academician.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，樞密使王峻上章，請解樞衡，凡三上章，詔不允。

translations.literal: On the yiyou day, Privy Council Commissioner Wang Jun submitted a memorial requesting release from the privy council; he submitted three memorials in all, and edicts refused consent.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Privy Council Commissioner Wang Jun submitted three memorials asking to be relieved of his post; each time the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，潁州奏，先於淮南俘獲孳畜，已準詔送還本土。

translations.literal: On the gengyin day, Ying Prefecture reported that livestock captured earlier in Huainan had been returned to their native lands as ordered by edict.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Ying Prefecture reported that livestock captured earlier in Huainan had been returned home as the edict required.

sentences.zh: 甲午，詔止絕吏民詣闕舉請刺史、縣令。

translations.literal: On the jiawu day, an edict forbade officials and commoners from coming to court to petition for appointment as prefects or magistrates.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, an edict forbade officials and commoners from coming to court to lobby for appointment as prefects or magistrates.

sentences.zh: 賜宰臣李穀白藤肩輿。

translations.literal: Grand Councilor Li Gu was granted a white-rattan sedan chair.
translations.idiomatic: Grand councilor Li Gu was given a white-rattan sedan chair.

sentences.zh: 時穀以今年七月，因步履傷臂，請告數旬，詔穀扶持三司，刻名印署事，仍放朝參。

translations.literal: At that time, in the seventh month of this year, Gu had injured his arm while walking and requested leave for several tens of days; an edict ordered Gu to oversee the Revenue Bureau, carve his name on the seal to transact business, and he was excused from court attendance.
translations.idiomatic: Gu had injured his arm while walking in the seventh month and asked for several weeks' leave. The emperor ordered him to continue overseeing the Revenue Bureau, authorized him to sign documents with a carved seal, and excused him from court.

sentences.zh: 庚子，潞州節度使常思移鎮宋州，相州節度使李筠移鎮潞州。

translations.literal: On the gengzi day, Luzhou Military Commissioner Chang Si was transferred to Song Prefecture, and Xiang Prefecture Military Commissioner Li Yun was transferred to Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Luzhou military commissioner Chang Si was transferred to Songzhou, and Xiangzhou military commissioner Li Yun was transferred to Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，鄆州節度使高行周薨。

translations.literal: On the renyin day, Yan Prefecture Military Commissioner Gao Xingzhou died.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Yanzhou military commissioner Gao Xingzhou died.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔改鹽曲法，鹽曲犯五斤已上處死，煎鹼鹽者犯一斤已上處死。

translations.literal: On the guichou day, an edict revised the law on salt yeast: those violating the salt-yeast prohibition by five jin or more were put to death; those illicitly boiling alkaline salt by one jin or more were put to death.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, an edict revised the salt laws: illicit salt yeast in amounts of five jin or more was punishable by death, as was illicit production of one jin or more of boiled alkaline salt.

sentences.zh: 先是，漢法不計斤兩多少，並處極刑，至是始革之。

translations.literal: Earlier, under Han law the amount in jin was not considered and all were punished by the extreme penalty; only now was this reformed.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Later Han, any violation regardless of amount had carried the death penalty; only now was that changed.

sentences.zh: 九月庚午，以大理卿劇可久為太僕卿，以左庶子張仁彖為大理卿，以司天監趙延乂為太府卿兼判司天監事。

translations.literal: On the gengwu day of the ninth month, Director of the Court of Judicial Review Ju Kejiu was made Director of the Court of the Imperial Stud; Left Household Supervisor Zhang Renlin was made Director of the Court of Judicial Review; Director of the Astronomical Bureau Zhao Yanyi was made Director of the Court of the Imperial Treasury and concurrently commissioner of the Astronomical Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu in the ninth month, director of the Court of Judicial Review Ju Kejiu became director of the Court of the Imperial Stud; left household supervisor Zhang Renlin became director of judicial review; and astronomical bureau director Zhao Yanyi became director of the imperial treasury while retaining charge of the astronomical bureau.

sentences.zh: 詔北面沿邊州鎮，自守疆埸，不得入北界俘掠。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the northern frontier prefectures and garrisons to guard their own borders and not enter the northern territories to capture and plunder.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered northern frontier prefectures to defend their own borders and forbade raids into Khitan territory.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，鎮州奏，契丹寇深、冀州，遣龍捷都指揮使劉誨、牙內都指揮使何繼筠等率兵拒之而退。

translations.literal: On the yihai day, Zhen Prefecture reported that the Khitan had raided Shen and Ji prefectures; Dragon Swift Commander Liu Hui, Headquarters Commander He Jiyun, and others were sent with troops to resist them, and they withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Zhen Prefecture reported a Khitan raid on Shen and Ji prefectures. Dragon Swift commander Liu Hui, headquarters commander He Jiyun, and others were sent to resist, and the Khitan withdrew.

sentences.zh: 時契丹聞官軍至，掠冀部丁壯數百隨行，狼狽而北，冀部被擄者望見官軍，鼓噪不已，官軍不敢進，其丁壯盡為蕃軍所殺而去。

translations.literal: At that time, when the Khitan heard the imperial army had arrived, they seized several hundred able-bodied men of Ji Prefecture to take with them and fled north in disorder; the captives from Ji Prefecture, seeing the imperial army, clamored without cease, but the imperial army dared not advance, and all the able-bodied men were killed by the barbarian army as it departed.
translations.idiomatic: When the Khitan heard the imperial army was coming, they seized several hundred Ji Prefecture men and fled north in disarray. The captives shouted to the Zhou troops when they came in sight, but the army dared not advance, and the Khitan killed all the captives as they withdrew.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以鄭州防禦使白重贊為相州留後。

translations.literal: On the dingchou day, Zheng Prefecture Defense Commissioner Bai Chongzan was made acting commissioner of Xiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Zhengzhou defense commissioner Bai Chongzan was appointed acting commissioner of Xiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，樂壽都監杜延熙奏，於瀛州南殺敗契丹，斬首三百級，獲馬四十七匹。

translations.literal: On the wuyin day, Leshou Garrison Supervisor Du Yanxi reported defeating the Khitan south of Ying Prefecture, taking three hundred heads and capturing forty-seven horses.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Leshou garrison supervisor Du Yanxi reported defeating the Khitan south of Yingzhou, taking three hundred heads and forty-seven horses.

sentences.zh: 癸未，帝姨母韓氏追封楚國夫人，故第四姊追封福慶長公主。

translations.literal: On the guiwei day, the emperor's maternal aunt Lady Han was posthumously enfeoffed as Lady of Chu State, and his deceased fourth elder sister was posthumously enfeoffed as Princess of Fuqing.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, the emperor's maternal aunt Lady Han was posthumously enfeoffed as lady of Chu, and his deceased fourth elder sister as Princess of Fuqing.

sentences.zh: 癸未，易州奏，契丹武州刺史石越來奔。

translations.literal: On the guiwei day, Yi Prefecture reported that Shi Yue, Prefect of Wu Prefecture under the Khitan, had come over in surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Yi Prefecture reported that Shi Yue, Khitan prefect of Wuzhou, had defected to the Zhou court.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙戌，以前晉州節度使王彥超為河陽節度使。

translations.literal: On the bingxu day of the tenth month of winter, former Jin Prefecture Military Commissioner Wang Yanchao was made Military Commissioner of Heyang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu in the tenth month of winter, former Jinzhou military commissioner Wang Yanchao was appointed military commissioner of Heyang.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔：「諸州罷任或朝覲，並不得以器械進貢。

translations.literal: On the gengyin day, an edict said: "When prefectures conclude their terms or come to court for audience, none may present arms and equipment as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, an edict declared: "When prefectural officials leave office or come to court, they may no longer present arms and equipment as tribute.

sentences.zh: 」先是，諸道州府，各有作院，每月課造軍器，逐季搬送京師進納。

translations.literal: " Earlier, each circuit's prefectures and districts had workshops that monthly levied production of military equipment, shipping it quarterly to the capital as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: " Previously each circuit had workshops that monthly produced arms and shipped them quarterly to the capital as tribute.

sentences.zh: 其逐州每年占留系省錢帛不少，謂之「甲料」，仍更於部內廣配土產物，征斂數倍，民甚苦之。

translations.literal: Each prefecture annually retained no small portion of provincial funds and silks, called "armor materials," and further widely assessed local products within its jurisdiction, levying several times the amount—the people suffered greatly.
translations.idiomatic: Each prefecture also retained large shares of provincial funds called "armor materials" and levied local products at several times the proper rate, to the people's great distress.

sentences.zh: 除上供軍器外，節度使、刺史又私造器甲，以進貢為名，功費又倍，悉取之於民。

translations.literal: Apart from arms supplied to the court, military commissioners and prefects also privately manufactured armor and weapons in the name of tribute presentation, with costs again doubled—all taken from the people.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond the arms owed to the court, commissioners and prefects also manufactured armor privately under the name of tribute, doubling the cost—all borne by the people.

sentences.zh: 帝以諸州器甲造作不精，兼占留屬省物用過當，乃令罷之。

translations.literal: The emperor, because the arms made in the prefectures were not finely crafted and because retention of provincial goods was excessive, ordered this abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Because the arms produced in the prefectures were poorly made and because retention of provincial goods had become excessive, the emperor ordered the practice abolished.

sentences.zh: 仍選擇諸道作工，赴京作坊，以備役使。

translations.literal: Skilled craftsmen from the various circuits were also selected to go to the capital workshops to be available for service.
translations.idiomatic: Skilled craftsmen from the circuits were selected to serve at the capital workshops instead.

sentences.zh: 乙未，永興軍奏，宣徽北院使、知軍府事翟光鄴卒。

translations.literal: On the yiwei day, Yongxing Army reported that Northern Bureau Commissioner of the Palace Secretariat and Administrator of the Military Prefecture Zhai Guangye had died.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Yongxing reported the death of Northern Bureau commissioner Zhai Guangye, who had been administering the military prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，葬德妃，廢朝。

translations.literal: On the dingyou day, the Virtuous Consort was buried and court was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, the Virtuous Consort was buried and court audiences were suspended.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以宣徽南院使袁鳷權知永興軍府事，以樞密直學士、工部侍郎陳觀權知開封府事。

translations.literal: On the wuxu day, Southern Bureau Commissioner Yuan Zhi was made acting administrator of Yongxing Military Prefecture; Privy Council Academician and Vice Minister of Works Chen Guan was made acting commissioner of Kaifeng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Southern Bureau commissioner Yuan Zhi was named acting administrator of Yongxing, and privy council academician Chen Guan acting commissioner of Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 己亥，升鉅野縣為濟州。

translations.literal: On the jihai day, Juye County was elevated to Ji Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Juye County was elevated to Jizhou prefecture.

sentences.zh: 以樞密院副使鄭仁誨為宣徽北院使兼樞密副使。

translations.literal: Vice Commissioner of the Privy Council Zheng Renhui was made Northern Bureau Commissioner of the Palace Secretariat and concurrently Vice Commissioner of the Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: Privy Council vice commissioner Zheng Renhui was appointed Northern Bureau commissioner while retaining his privy council post.

sentences.zh: 庚子，幸樞密院，王峻請之也。

translations.literal: On the gengzi day, the emperor visited the Privy Council—at Wang Jun's request.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, at Wang Jun's invitation, the emperor visited the Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，宰臣李穀以臂傷未愈，上表辭位，凡三上章，詔報不允。

translations.literal: On the jiachen day, Grand Councilor Li Gu, because his arm injury had not healed, submitted a memorial resigning his post; he submitted three memorials in all, and edicts in reply refused consent.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Grand Councilor Li Gu, whose arm had not yet healed, submitted three memorials resigning his post; each time the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 丁未，滄州奏，自十月已前，蕃歸漢戶萬九千八百戶。

translations.literal: On the dingwei day, Cang Prefecture reported that before the tenth month, nineteen thousand eight hundred barbarian households had returned to Han rule.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Cangzhou reported that before the tenth month, 19,800 households had returned from Khitan rule to the Zhou.

sentences.zh: 是時，北境饑謹，人民轉徙，繈負而歸中土者，散居河北州縣，凡數十萬口。

translations.literal: At this time the northern border suffered famine; the people migrated, and those who returned to the Central Plains carrying infants on their backs were scattered through the prefectures and counties of Hebei—in all several hundred thousand persons.
translations.idiomatic: The northern frontier was then suffering famine, and refugees carrying infants on their backs returned to the Central Plains in the hundreds of thousands, scattered across the prefectures of Hebei.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙辰，荊南奏，朗州大將劉言，以今年十月三日領兵趨長沙，十五日至潭州，淮南所署湖南節度使邊鎬、岳州刺史宋德權並棄城遁去。

translations.literal: On the bingchen day of the eleventh month, Jingnan reported that Lang Prefecture great general Liu Yan, on the third day of the tenth month of this year, led troops toward Changsha and on the fifteenth reached Tan Prefecture; Huainan's appointed Hunan Military Commissioner Bian Hao and Yue Prefecture Prefect Song Dequan both abandoned their cities and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen in the eleventh month, Jingnan reported that Langzhou general Liu Yan had marched on Changsha on the third of the tenth month and reached Tanzhou on the fifteenth. Southern Tang's appointees Bian Hao and Yuezhou prefect Song Dequan had both abandoned their cities and fled.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以前少府監馬從斌為殿中監。

translations.literal: On the gengshen day, former Director of the Palace Workshops Ma Congbin was made Director of the Palace Domestic Service.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, former director of the Palace Workshops Ma Congbin was appointed director of the Palace Domestic Service.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，樞密使王峻亡妻崔氏追封趙國夫人，非故事也。

translations.literal: On the renxu day, the deceased wife of Privy Council Commissioner Wang Jun, Lady Cui, was posthumously enfeoffed as Lady of Zhao State—not according to precedent.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Wang Jun's deceased wife Lady Cui was posthumously enfeoffed as lady of Zhao—contrary to precedent.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，刑部尚書張沆卒。

translations.literal: On the yichou day, Minister of Justice Zhang Hong died.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, minister of justice Zhang Hong died.

sentences.zh: 辛未，陜州折從阮移鎮邠州。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day, Zhe Congruan of Shan Prefecture was transferred to Bin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Zhe Congruan of Shanzhou was transferred to Binzhou.

sentences.zh: 以前宋州節度使李洪義為安州節度使。

translations.literal: Former Song Prefecture Military Commissioner Li Hongyi was made Military Commissioner of An Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Former Songzhou military commissioner Li Hongyi was appointed military commissioner of Anzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，青州符彥卿移鎮鄆州。

translations.literal: On the guiyou day, Fu Yanqing of Qing Prefecture was transferred to Yan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Fu Yanqing of Qingzhou was transferred to Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，詔曰：「累朝已來，用兵不息，至於繕治甲胄，未免配役生靈，多取於民，助成軍器。

translations.literal: On the jiaxu day, an edict said: "For successive dynasties warfare has not ceased; as for repairing armor, corvée of the people could not be avoided, much was taken from the populace to supply military equipment.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, an edict declared: "For generations warfare has not ceased, and the repair of armor has required corvée labor and heavy levies on the people to supply the armies.

sentences.zh: 就中皮革，尤峻科刑，稍犯嚴條，皆抵極典，鄉縣以之生事，奸猾得以侵漁，宜立新規，用革前弊。

translations.literal: Among these, leather was especially harshly punished; the slightest violation of the strict statutes met the extreme penalty. Districts and counties used this to create trouble, and the cunning were able to extort—new regulations should be established to reform former abuses.
translations.idiomatic: Leather in particular was punished most harshly: even minor violations brought the death penalty. Local officials used the law to harass the people, and the unscrupulous to extort them. New regulations are needed to end these abuses.

sentences.zh: 應天下所納牛皮，今將逐所納數，三分內減二分，其一分於人戶苗畝上配定。

translations.literal: For all ox hides submitted throughout the realm, of the amount submitted at each place two-thirds within three parts shall be reduced, and the remaining one-third shall be assessed on households according to seedling acreage.
translations.idiomatic: The ox hides required from the realm shall be reduced by two-thirds; the remaining third shall be assessed on households according to their tax acreage.

sentences.zh: 每秋夏苗共十頃納連角皮一張，其黃牛納幹筋四兩，水牛半斤，犢子皮不在納限。

translations.literal: For every ten qing of summer and autumn seedling tax, one hide with horns attached shall be submitted; for yellow cattle, four liang of dried sinew; for water buffalo, half a jin; calf hides are not within the levy limit.
translations.idiomatic: For every ten qing of summer and autumn tax land, one hide with horns attached is due; for yellow cattle, four liang of dried sinew; for water buffalo, half a jin. Calf hides are exempt.

sentences.zh: 牛馬驢騾皮筋角，今後官中更不禁斷，只不得將出化外敵境。

translations.literal: Ox, horse, donkey, and mule hides, sinews, and horns—henceforth the court will no longer prohibit them, but they may not be taken out beyond the border into enemy territory.
translations.idiomatic: Hides, sinews, and horns of cattle, horses, donkeys, and mules may no longer be banned by the court, but may not be exported beyond the border to enemy lands.

sentences.zh: 州縣先置巡檢牛皮節級並停。

translations.literal: The ox-hide inspector ranks previously established in prefectures and counties are all abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The ox-hide inspector posts previously established in prefectures and counties are abolished.

sentences.zh: 」丙子，詔曰：「應內外文武官僚幕職、州縣官舉選人等，今後有父母、祖父母亡歿未經遷葬者，其主家之長，不得輒求仕進，所由司亦不得申舉解送。

translations.literal: " On the bingzi day, an edict said: "All civil and military officials within and without, staff officers, prefectural and county officials, and examination candidates—hereafter, if parents or grandparents have died and not yet been reburied, the head of the main household may not seek advancement in office, and the responsible agencies may not recommend or forward them.
translations.idiomatic: " On bingzi, an edict declared: "All civil and military officials, staff officers, prefectural and county officials, and examination candidates whose parents or grandparents have died but not yet been reburied may not seek office, and responsible agencies may not recommend them.

sentences.zh: 如是卑幼在下者，不在此限。

translations.literal: If junior kin are below in the household, they are not within this restriction.
translations.idiomatic: Junior members of the household who are not heads of family are exempt.

sentences.zh: 」己卯，日南至，帝御崇元殿受朝賀，仗衛如儀。

translations.literal: " On the jimao day, the winter solstice; the emperor took the throne in Chongyuan Hall to receive court congratulations, with guards and insignia according to ritual.
translations.idiomatic: " On jimao, the winter solstice, the emperor held court in Chongyuan Hall with full ceremonial guard.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙戌，權武平軍留後劉言遣牙將張崇嗣入奏，於十月十三日，與節度副使王進逵、行軍司馬何敬貞、指揮使周行逢等，同共部領戰棹，攻收湖南，偽節度使邊鎬當夜出奔，王進逵等已入潭州。

translations.literal: On the bingxu day of the twelfth month, Acting Commissioner of Wuping Army Liu Yan sent his staff officer Zhang Chongsi to report: on the thirteenth day of the tenth month, together with Deputy Military Commissioner Wang Jinkui, Campaign Marshal He Jingzhen, Commander Zhou Xingfeng, and others, they jointly led warships to attack and recover Hunan; the false Military Commissioner Bian Hao fled that night, and Wang Jinkui and the others had already entered Tan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu in the twelfth month, acting Wuping army commissioner Liu Yan sent his staff officer Zhang Chongsi to report that on the thirteenth of the tenth month he had joined deputy commissioner Wang Jinkui, campaign marshal He Jingzhen, commander Zhou Xingfeng, and others in a naval attack on Hunan. Southern Tang commissioner Bian Hao had fled that night, and Wang Jinkui's forces had entered Tanzhou.

sentences.zh: （《九國誌·王逵傳》：逵，朗州武陵人，或名進逵。

translations.literal: (Chronicle of the Nine States, Biography of Wang Kui: Kui was a native of Wuling in Lang Prefecture, also called Jinkui.
translations.idiomatic: (According to the Chronicle of the Nine States, Biography of Wang Kui: Kui was from Wuling in Lang Prefecture and was also known as Jinkui.

sentences.zh: 邊鎬為武安軍節度使，召劉言入覲，言不行，謀於逵曰：「江南召我，不往，必加兵於我矣，為之奈何！

translations.literal: Bian Hao was Military Commissioner of Wu'an Army and summoned Liu Yan to court; Yan would not go and consulted Kui, saying: "The south calls me; if I do not go, they will surely send troops against me—what is to be done!
translations.idiomatic: Bian Hao was military commissioner of the Wu'an army and summoned Liu Yan to court. Yan refused and asked Kui, "The south has summoned me. If I do not go, they will attack—what should I do?

sentences.zh: 」逵曰：「鎬之此來，以制置潭、朗為名，公如速行，正入其算。

translations.literal: " Kui said: "Hao has come on the pretext of administering Tan and Lang; if you go quickly, you walk right into his plan.
translations.idiomatic: " Kui replied, "Hao has come under the pretext of administering Tan and Lang. If you go to court now, you walk straight into his trap.

sentences.zh: 武陵負江湖之阻，帶甲百萬，乃欲拱手臣異姓乎？

translations.literal: Wuling lies behind the barriers of rivers and lakes, with a million armored men—do you wish to bow and submit to a different surname?
translations.idiomatic: Wuling lies behind the Yangzi's barriers with a hundred thousand armed men—will you simply bow to a foreign ruler?

sentences.zh: 鎬新至長沙，經略未定，乘人心憤怒，引兵攻鎬，可一鼓而擒也。

translations.literal: Hao has newly arrived at Changsha and his control is not yet settled; seize the moment when hearts are angry, lead troops to attack Hao, and he can be captured in one drumbeat.
translations.idiomatic: Hao has only just reached Changsha and his control is not secure. Strike while the people are angry, attack him at once, and you can take him in a single assault.

sentences.zh: 」言然之，乃遣與何景真等同起兵於武陵，號十指揮使，以攻邊鎬。

translations.literal: " Yan agreed; he then sent He Jingzhen and others to raise troops together at Wuling, styling themselves the Ten-Finger Commanders, to attack Bian Hao.
translations.idiomatic: " Yan agreed and sent He Jingzhen and others to raise troops at Wuling under the title Ten-Finger Commanders to attack Bian Hao.

sentences.zh: 逵率舟師南上，至長沙，邊鎬大駭，以所部奔歸江南，諸州屯守皆罷之，盡復湖外之地。）〉

translations.literal: Kui led the fleet south to Changsha; Bian Hao was greatly alarmed and fled with his forces back to Jiangnan; garrisons in the various prefectures were all withdrawn, and all lands beyond the lakes were recovered.)]
translations.idiomatic: Kui led the fleet south to Changsha. Bian Hao fled in alarm to Jiangnan with his troops, the garrisons were withdrawn, and all territory beyond the lakes was recovered.)]

sentences.zh: 癸巳，太子太師致仕安叔千卒。

translations.literal: On the guisi day, Retired Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent An Shuqian died.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, retired grand preceptor of the heir apparent An Shuqian died.
