sentences.zh: 甲午，詔今後諸侯入朝，不得進奉買宴。

translations.literal: On the jiawu day, an edict ordered that henceforth when feudatories came to court they might not present tribute to purchase banquets.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, an edict forbade feudatories coming to court from presenting tribute to pay for banquets.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，皇子澶州節度使榮落起復，加同平章事。

translations.literal: On the dingyou day, the prince, Military Commissioner of Chan Prefecture Rong, ended mourning and was recalled to office, and made Associate Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Prince Rong of Chanzhou ended mourning and was recalled to office as associate grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，太子少傅致仕王延卒。

translations.literal: On the wuxu day, Retired Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent Wang Yan died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, retired junior tutor of the heir apparent Wang Yan died.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，幸西莊。

translations.literal: On the renyin day, the emperor visited the Western Villa.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, the emperor visited the Western Villa.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以端明殿學士顏衎權知開封府事。

translations.literal: On the yisi day, Duanming Hall Academician Yan Yan was made acting commissioner of Kaifeng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Duanming Hall academician Yan Yan was appointed acting commissioner of Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 御史臺奏：「請改左右衛復為左右屯衛。

translations.literal: The Censorate memorialized: "We request that the Left and Right Guards be changed back to the Left and Right Garrison Guards.
translations.idiomatic: The Censorate memorialized: "We ask that the Left and Right Guards be renamed the Left and Right Garrison Guards.

sentences.zh: 」從之，避御名也。

translations.literal: " Consent was given—to avoid the imperial personal name.
translations.idiomatic: " The request was granted, to avoid the emperor's personal name.

sentences.zh: 是冬無雪。

translations.literal: That winter there was no snow.
translations.idiomatic: That winter brought no snow.

sentences.zh: 廣順三年春正月壬子朔，帝御崇元殿受朝賀，仗衛如儀。

translations.literal: On the renzi new moon of the first month of spring in the third year of Guangshun, the emperor took the throne in Chongyuan Hall to receive court congratulations, with guards and insignia according to ritual.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the first month of spring in the third year of Guangshun, renzi, the emperor held court in Chongyuan Hall with full ceremonial guard.

sentences.zh: 幸太平宮起居漢太后。

translations.literal: He visited Taiping Palace to inquire after the Han Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: He visited Taiping Palace to pay his respects to the Han empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，賜群臣射於內鞠場。

translations.literal: On the jiayin day, the officials were granted archery in the inner ball court.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, the emperor granted the officials an archery session in the inner ball court.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，武平軍兵馬留後劉言奏：「潭州干戈之後，焚燒殆盡，乞移使府於武陵。

translations.literal: On the yimao day, Wuping Army Acting Commander of Troops and Horses Liu Yan memorialized: "After the warfare at Tan Prefecture, it has been nearly all burned; we beg to move the commissionerate to Wuling.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, acting Wuping army commander Liu Yan memorialized: "Tanzhou has been nearly destroyed by war. We ask that the commissionerate be moved to Wuling.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Consent was given.
translations.idiomatic: " The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 詔升朗州為大都督府，在潭州之上。

translations.literal: An edict elevated Lang Prefecture to a great military governorship, ranking above Tan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: An edict elevated Langzhou to a great military governorship ranking above Tanzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以武平軍節度使留後、檢校太尉劉言為檢校太師、同平章事，行朗州大都督，充武平軍節度兼三司水陸轉運等使，制置武安、靜江等軍事，進封彭城郡公；

translations.literal: On the bingchen day, Wuping Army Acting Military Commissioner and Honorary Grand Guardian Liu Yan was made Honorary Grand Preceptor and Associate Grand Councilor, acting Great Military Governor of Lang Prefecture, Commissioner of Wuping Army and Revenue Bureau water and land transport commissioner, Controller of Wu'an, Jingjiang, and other military affairs, and advanced to Duke of Pengcheng Commandery;
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, acting Wuping commissioner Liu Yan was made honorary grand preceptor and associate grand councilor, acting great military governor of Langzhou, commissioner of Wuping army and water and land transport, controller of Wu'an and Jingjiang military affairs, and enfeoffed as duke of Pengcheng;

sentences.zh: 武平軍節度副使、權知潭州軍州事、檢校太傅王進逵為檢校太尉，行潭州刺史，充武安軍節度使；

translations.literal: Wuping Army Deputy Military Commissioner, Acting Administrator of Tan Prefecture military and civil affairs, and Honorary Grand Tutor Wang Jinkui was made Honorary Grand Guardian, acting Prefect of Tan Prefecture, and Military Commissioner of Wu'an Army;
translations.idiomatic: deputy commissioner Wang Jinkui was made honorary grand guardian, acting prefect of Tanzhou, and military commissioner of the Wu'an army;

sentences.zh: 以武安軍行軍司馬兼衙內步軍都指揮使、檢校太傅何敬貞為檢校太尉，行桂州刺史，充靜江軍節度使；

translations.literal: Wu'an Army Campaign Marshal and Headquarters Infantry Commander He Jingzhen, Honorary Grand Tutor, was made Honorary Grand Guardian, acting Prefect of Gui Prefecture, and Military Commissioner of Jingjiang Army;
translations.idiomatic: campaign marshal He Jingzhen was made honorary grand guardian, acting prefect of Guizhou, and military commissioner of the Jingjiang army;

sentences.zh: 以張仿領眉州刺史，充武平軍節度副使；

translations.literal: Zhang Fang was made Prefect of Mei Prefecture and Deputy Military Commissioner of Wuping Army;
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Fang was made prefect of Meizhou and deputy commissioner of Wuping army;

sentences.zh: 以朱元琇領黃州刺史，充靜江軍節度副使；

translations.literal: Zhu Yuanxiu was made Prefect of Huang Prefecture and Deputy Military Commissioner of Jingjiang Army;
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Yuanxiu was made prefect of Huangzhou and deputy commissioner of Jingjiang army;

sentences.zh: 以周行逢領集州刺史，充武安軍節度行軍司馬。

translations.literal: Zhou Xingfeng was made Prefect of Ji Prefecture and Campaign Marshal of Wu'an Army.
translations.idiomatic: and Zhou Xingfeng was made prefect of Jizhou and campaign marshal of the Wu'an army.

sentences.zh: 自進逵而下，皆劉言將校也。

translations.literal: From Jinkui downward, all were Liu Yan's officers and commanders.
translations.idiomatic: From Jinkui downward, all were officers under Liu Yan.

sentences.zh: 邠州奏，慶州略蕃部野雞族略奪商旅，侵擾州界。

translations.literal: Bin Prefecture reported that the Yeji tribe of Qing Prefecture's frontier barbarians were robbing merchants and travelers and raiding the prefectural border.
translations.idiomatic: Binzhou reported that the Yeji tribe on Qingzhou's frontier was robbing merchants and raiding the border.

sentences.zh: 詔遣寧州刺史張建武等率兵掩襲，仍先賜敕書安撫，如不從命，即進軍問罪。

translations.literal: An edict dispatched Ning Prefecture Prefect Zhang Jianwu and others to lead troops in a surprise attack, while first sending an imperial letter of reassurance; if they did not obey, troops would advance to punish them.
translations.idiomatic: An edict sent Ningzhou prefect Zhang Jianwu and others to strike by surprise, but first sent a letter of reassurance; if the tribe refused, they were to march and punish them.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔賜朗州劉言應兩京及諸道舊屬湖南樓店邸第。

translations.literal: On the xinyou day, an edict granted Liu Yan of Lang Prefecture the shops and mansions in the two capitals and various circuits formerly belonging to Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, an edict granted Liu Yan the shops and mansions in both capitals and the circuits that had formerly belonged to Hunan.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔：「諸道州府系屬戶部營田及租稅課利等，除京兆府莊宅務、贍國軍榷鹽務、兩京行從莊外，其餘並割屬州縣，所征租稅課利，官中只管舊額，其職員節級一切停廢。

translations.literal: On the yichou day, an edict said: "The revenue farms and tax and levy items under the Ministry of Revenue in the various circuits' prefectures and districts—apart from the Jingzhao Estates Office, the State-Supporting Army Salt Monopoly Office, and the two capitals' processional estates—all the rest are to be transferred to prefectures and counties. Taxes and levies collected shall be kept only to the old quotas by the court, and all staff ranks are abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, an edict declared: "Revenue farms and tax levies under the Ministry of Revenue in the circuits—except the Jingzhao Estates Office, the state salt monopoly, and the two capitals' processional estates—shall be transferred to prefectures and counties. Collections shall not exceed former quotas, and all related posts are abolished.

sentences.zh: 應有客戶元佃系省莊田、桑土、舍宇，便賜逐戶，充為永業，仍仰縣司給與憑由。

translations.literal: Tenant clients who formerly cultivated provincial estates, mulberry lands, and houses shall be granted them household by household as permanent property, and the county offices are to issue certificates.
translations.idiomatic: Tenant farmers on former provincial estates, mulberry lands, and houses shall receive them as permanent property, with certificates issued by the county offices.

sentences.zh: 應諸處元屬營田戶部院及系縣人戶所納租中課利，起今年後並與除放。

translations.literal: All levies formerly paid in rent by revenue-farm households under the Ministry of Revenue and by county households are remitted from this year forward.
translations.idiomatic: All levies formerly paid on revenue-farm and county household rents are remitted from this year forward.

sentences.zh: 所有見牛犢並賜本戶，官中永不收系」云。

translations.literal: All oxen and calves presently held are granted to their households, and the court will never seize them again."
translations.idiomatic: All oxen and calves in official hands are granted to their households, and the court will never seize them again."

sentences.zh: 帝在民間，素知營田之弊，至是以天下系官莊田僅萬計，悉以分賜見佃戶充永業。

translations.literal: When the emperor was among the people, he had long known the abuses of revenue farms; now nearly ten thousand court estates throughout the realm were all distributed to present tenant households as permanent property.
translations.idiomatic: Having known the abuses of revenue farms from his years among the people, the emperor now distributed nearly ten thousand court estates throughout the realm to their tenant farmers as permanent property.

sentences.zh: 是歲出戶三萬餘，百姓既得為己業，比戶欣然，於是葺屋植樹，敢致功力。

translations.literal: That year more than thirty thousand households were released; once the people held land as their own, every household was glad, and they then repaired houses, planted trees, and dared to apply their labor.
translations.idiomatic: More than thirty thousand households benefited that year. Once the land was their own, families rejoiced, repaired their homes, planted trees, and labored with new confidence.

sentences.zh: 又，東南郡邑各有租牛課戶，往因梁太祖渡淮，軍士掠民牛以千萬計，梁太祖盡給與諸州民，輸租課，自是六十餘載，時移代改，牛租猶在，百姓苦之，至是特與除放。

translations.literal: Moreover, southeastern prefectures and districts each had ox-rent levy households. Formerly, when Emperor Taizu of Liang crossed the Huai, soldiers seized civilian oxen by the millions; Emperor Taizu of Liang gave them all to the people of the various prefectures to pay rent levies. From then for more than sixty years, though times and dynasties changed, ox rent remained, and the people suffered—only now was it specially remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Southeastern districts also had ox-rent households dating from when Liang Taizu crossed the Huai and his soldiers seized millions of civilian oxen, which he then distributed to the people for rent payments. For more than sixty years, through successive dynasties, the ox rent had remained a burden—now it was finally abolished.

sentences.zh: 未幾，京兆府莊宅務及榷鹽務亦歸州縣，依例處分。

translations.literal: Before long, the Jingzhao Estates Office and the Salt Monopoly Office also reverted to prefectures and counties and were handled according to regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the Jingzhao Estates Office and the salt monopoly were also transferred to prefectural control under the same policy.

sentences.zh: 或有上言，以天下系官莊田，甚有可惜者，若遣貨之，當得三十萬緡，亦可資國用。

translations.literal: Someone memorialized that the court estates throughout the realm were much to be regretted; if sold, they might fetch three hundred thousand strings of cash, which could also supply state needs.
translations.idiomatic: Someone suggested that selling the court estates could bring three hundred thousand strings of cash for state revenue.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「茍利於民，與資國何異。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "If it benefits the people, how does that differ from supplying the state?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied, "If it benefits the people, how is that different from enriching the state?

sentences.zh: 」丁卯，戶部侍郎、權知貢舉趙上交奏：「諸科舉人，欲等第各加對義場數；

translations.literal: " On the dingmao day, Vice Minister of Revenue and Acting Commissioner of Examinations Zhao Shangjiao memorialized: "For candidates in the various examination categories, we wish to add sessions of policy discourse according to rank;
translations.idiomatic: " On dingmao, vice minister of revenue and acting examination commissioner Zhao Shangjiao memorialized that additional policy-discourse sessions be added for each examination rank;

sentences.zh: 進士除詩賦外，別試雜文一場。

translations.literal: for jinshi, apart from poetry and rhapsody, there shall be a separate examination in miscellaneous prose.
translations.idiomatic: and that jinshi candidates, beyond poetry and rhapsody, take an additional examination in miscellaneous prose.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Consent was given.
translations.idiomatic: " The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 兩浙吊祭使、左諫議大夫李知損責授登州司馬，員外置，仍令所在馳驛放遣。

translations.literal: Li Zhisun, condolence envoy to the two Zhe regions and Left Reminder, was demoted to Deng Prefecture Vice-Prefect, supernumerary appointment, and ordered dispatched by express relay from his location.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zhisun, condolence envoy to the two Zhes and Left Reminder, was demoted to supernumerary vice-prefect of Dengzhou and ordered sent home by express relay.

sentences.zh: 知損銜命江、浙，所經藩郡，皆強貸於侯伯，為青州知州張凝所奏，故有是命。

translations.literal: Zhisun, on mission to Jiang and Zhe, at every feudatory commandery he passed forced loans from the marquises and earls; Qing Prefecture Prefect Zhang Ning memorialized against him, hence this order.
translations.idiomatic: On his mission to Jiang and Zhe, Zhisun had extorted loans from local lords at every stop. Qingzhou prefect Zhang Ning reported him, leading to this punishment.

sentences.zh: 己巳，幸南莊。

translations.literal: On the jisi day, the emperor visited the Southern Villa.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, the emperor visited the Southern Villa.

sentences.zh: 臨水亭，見雙鳧戲於池上，帝引弓射之，一發疊貫，從臣稱賀。

translations.literal: At the waterside pavilion he saw two mandarin ducks sporting on the pool; the emperor drew his bow and shot them, piercing both with one arrow, and his attendants offered congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: At the waterside pavilion he saw two mandarin ducks on the pond, drew his bow, and pierced both with a single arrow. His attendants congratulated him.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以前邠州節度使侯章為鄧州節度使。

translations.literal: On the gengwu day, former Bin Prefecture Military Commissioner Hou Zhang was made Military Commissioner of Deng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, former Binzhou military commissioner Hou Zhang was appointed military commissioner of Dengzhou.

sentences.zh: 前萊州刺史葉仁魯賜死，坐為民所訟故也。

translations.literal: Former Laizhou Prefect Ye Renlu was granted death by imperial favor, because the people had sued him.
translations.idiomatic: Former Laizhou prefect Ye Renlu was ordered to take his own life after the people brought suit against him.

sentences.zh: 辛未，詔樞密使王峻巡視河堤。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day, an edict ordered Privy Council Commissioner Wang Jun to inspect the river dikes.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, an edict ordered Privy Council Commissioner Wang Jun to inspect the Yellow River dikes.

sentences.zh: 峻請行，故從之。

translations.literal: Jun had requested to go, hence consent was given.
translations.idiomatic: Jun had asked to make the tour, and the emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，幸南莊。

translations.literal: On the xinsi day, the emperor visited the Southern Villa.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, the emperor visited the Southern Villa.

sentences.zh: 閏月甲申，朗州劉言、潭州王進逵奏，廣賊占據桂管，深入永州界俘劫，遣朗州行軍司馬何敬貞與指揮使朱全琇、陳順等，率水陸軍五萬進擊。

translations.literal: On the jiashen day of the intercalary month, Liu Yan of Lang Prefecture and Wang Jinkui of Tan Prefecture reported that Guang bandits held Guiguan, had penetrated deep into Yong Prefecture territory to capture and plunder, and had dispatched Lang Prefecture Campaign Marshal He Jingzhen with Commanders Zhu Quanxiu, Chen Shun, and others to lead fifty thousand land and water troops in attack.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen in the intercalary month, Liu Yan and Wang Jinkui reported that Guang bandits held Guiguan and were raiding deep into Yongzhou. They had sent campaign marshal He Jingzhen with Zhu Quanxiu, Chen Shun, and others at the head of fifty thousand troops by land and water.

sentences.zh: 丙戊，回鶻遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: On the bingxu day, the Uyghurs sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Uyghur envoys arrived with tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 詔故梁租庸使趙巖侄崇勛，見居陳州，量賜系官店宅，從王峻之請也。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that Chongxun, nephew of former Liang Rent and Corvée Commissioner Zhao Yan, now residing in Chen Prefecture, be granted court shops and mansions in appropriate measure—at Wang Jun's request.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted court shops and mansions in Chenzhou to Chongxun, nephew of the former Liang rent commissioner Zhao Yan, at Wang Jun's request.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，定州奏，契丹攻義豐軍，出勁兵夜斫蕃營，斬首六十級，契丹遁去。

translations.literal: On the xinmao day, Ding Prefecture reported that the Khitan attacked Yifeng Garrison; elite troops were sent out to strike the barbarian camp by night, taking sixty heads, and the Khitan fled.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Dingzhou reported a Khitan attack on Yifeng Garrison. Elite troops struck the enemy camp by night, took sixty heads, and the Khitan withdrew.

sentences.zh: 甲午，鎮州奏，契丹寇境，遣兵追襲，至無極而還。

translations.literal: On the jiawu day, Zhen Prefecture reported that the Khitan had raided the border; troops were sent in pursuit as far as Wuji and then returned.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Zhenzhou reported a Khitan border raid. Pursuit troops chased them as far as Wuji and then returned.

sentences.zh: 丙申，皇子澶州節度使榮來朝。

translations.literal: On the bingshen day, the prince, Military Commissioner of Chan Prefecture Rong, came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Prince Rong of Chanzhou came to court.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以樞密使、尚書左僕射、同平章事、監修國史王峻兼青州節度使，餘如故。

translations.literal: On the renyin day, Privy Council Commissioner, Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Grand Councilor, and Commissioner for Editing the National History Wang Jun was made concurrent Military Commissioner of Qing Prefecture; his other posts remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, privy council commissioner and grand councilor Wang Jun was also appointed military commissioner of Qingzhou while retaining his other posts.

sentences.zh: 延州衙內指揮使高紹基奏言：「父允權患腳膝，令臣權知軍州事。

translations.literal: Yan Prefecture Headquarters Commander Gao Shaoji memorialized: "My father Yunquan suffers from the knee and has ordered me to serve as acting administrator of military and civil affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Yanzhou headquarters commander Gao Shaoji reported: "My father Yunquan is ill in the knee and has placed me in charge of military and civil affairs.

sentences.zh: 」癸卯，陳州奏：「吏民請與前刺史李穀立祠堂。

translations.literal: " On the guimao day, Chen Prefecture reported: "Officials and commoners request that a shrine be erected to the former prefect Li Gu.
translations.idiomatic: " On guimao, Chenzhou reported that officials and commoners wished to erect a shrine to the former prefect Li Gu.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Consent was given.
translations.idiomatic: " The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 時穀為宰相，聞郡人陳請，遜讓數四，乃止。

translations.literal: At that time Gu was grand councilor; hearing the county people's petition, he declined four times, and it was then stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Gu was then grand councilor. When he heard of the petition, he declined four times, and the plan was dropped.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，鄴都留守王殷加檢校太尉，依前同平章事。

translations.literal: On the jiachen day, Yedu Regent Wang Yin was made Honorary Grand Guardian, continuing as before as Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Yedu regent Wang Yin was made honorary grand guardian while retaining his post as grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 丙午，鎮州節度使何福進、河陽節度使王彥超並加檢校太尉，潞州節度使李筠加檢校太傅。

translations.literal: On the bingwu day, Zhen Prefecture Military Commissioner He Fujin and Heyang Military Commissioner Wang Yanchao were both made Honorary Grand Guardians; Luzhou Military Commissioner Li Yun was made Honorary Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Zhenzhou commissioner He Fujin and Heyang commissioner Wang Yanchao were made honorary grand guardians, and Luzhou commissioner Li Yun honorary grand tutor.

sentences.zh: 丁未，延州節度使高允權卒。

translations.literal: On the dingwei day, Yan Prefecture Military Commissioner Gao Yunquan died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Yanzhou military commissioner Gao Yunquan died.

sentences.zh: 己酉，開封府奏，都城內錄到無名額僧尼寺院五十八所。

translations.literal: On the jiyou day, Kaifeng Prefecture reported that fifty-eight Buddhist and Daoist temples and monasteries without official registers had been recorded within the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Kaifeng reported fifty-eight unregistered Buddhist and Daoist establishments in the capital.

sentences.zh: 詔廢之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered them abolished.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered them closed.

sentences.zh: 二月辛亥朔，以前西京留守白文珂為太子太師致仕，進封韓國公。

translations.literal: On the xinhai new moon of the second month, former Western Capital Regent Bai Wenke was made Retired Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent and advanced to Duke of Han State.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the second month, xinhai, former Western Capital regent Bai Wenke retired as grand preceptor of the heir apparent and was enfeoffed as duke of Han.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，安州節度使李洪義、侍衛馬軍都指揮使郭崇、侍衛步軍都指揮使曹英，並加檢校太尉。

translations.literal: On the guichou day, An Prefecture Military Commissioner Li Hongyi, Palace Guard Cavalry Commander Guo Chong, and Palace Guard Infantry Commander Cao Ying were all made Honorary Grand Guardians.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Anzhou commissioner Li Hongyi, cavalry commander Guo Chong, and infantry commander Cao Ying were all made honorary grand guardians.

sentences.zh: 唐州方城縣令陳守愚棄市，坐克留戶民蠶鹽一千五百斤入己也。

translations.literal: Chen Shouyu, magistrate of Fangcheng County in Tang Prefecture, was executed in the marketplace for retaining fifteen hundred jin of household silkworm salt for himself.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Shouyu, magistrate of Fangcheng in Tangzhou, was executed for embezzling fifteen hundred jin of household silkworm salt.

sentences.zh: 內制國寶兩座，詔中書令馮道書寶文，其一以「皇帝承天受命之寶」為文，其一以「皇帝神寶」為文。

translations.literal: Two imperial seals were made within the palace; an edict ordered Chief Councilor Feng Dao to inscribe the seal texts—one with the text "Seal of the Emperor Who Receives the Mandate from Heaven," the other with "Imperial Divine Seal."
translations.idiomatic: Two imperial seals were commissioned, and Chief Councilor Feng Dao was ordered to inscribe them—one reading "Seal of the Emperor Who Receives Heaven's Mandate," the other "Imperial Divine Seal."

sentences.zh: 案，傳國寶始自秦始皇，令李斯篆之，歷代傳授，事具前史。

translations.literal: Note: the transmission seal began with Qin Shihuang, who ordered Li Si to engrave it; it was handed down through successive dynasties, as detailed in earlier histories.
translations.idiomatic: The transmission seal dated from the First Emperor of Qin, who had Li Si engrave it. It passed through successive dynasties, as earlier histories record.

sentences.zh: 至唐末帝自燔之際，以寶隨身，遂俱焚焉。

translations.literal: When the last Tang emperor burned himself, he took the seal with him, and it was burned together with him.
translations.idiomatic: When the last Tang emperor burned himself, he took the seal with him, and it perished in the flames.

sentences.zh: 晉高祖受命，特制寶一座，開運末，契丹犯闕，少帝遣其子延煦送於戎王，戎主，訝其非真，少帝上表具訴其事，及契丹北歸，賫以入蕃。

translations.literal: When Jin Gaozu received the Mandate, a special seal was made. At the end of Kaiyun, when the Khitan invaded the capital, the Young Emperor sent his son Yanshu to present it to the barbarian ruler; the barbarian ruler doubted it was genuine, and the Young Emperor submitted a memorial explaining the matter in full. When the Khitan returned north, they carried it into their lands.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Gaozu had a new seal made when he took the throne. At the end of Kaiyun, when the Khitan seized the capital, the young emperor sent his son Yanshu to present it to the Khitan ruler, who doubted its authenticity. The young emperor explained in a memorial, but when the Khitan withdrew north, they carried the seal away.

sentences.zh: 漢朝二帝，未暇別制，至是始創為之。

translations.literal: The two emperors of Han had had no leisure to make new ones; only now were they first created.
translations.idiomatic: The two Later Han emperors had had no time to commission new ones; only now were they created.

sentences.zh: 庚申，遣將作監李瓊知陜州軍州事。

translations.literal: On the gengshen day, Director of Palace Construction Li Qiong was dispatched to administer Shan Prefecture military and civil affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, director of palace construction Li Qiong was sent to administer Shanzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲子，樞密使、平盧軍節度使、尚書左僕射、平章事、監修國史王峻責授商州司馬，員外置，所在馳驛發遣。

translations.literal: On the jiazi day, Privy Council Commissioner, Pinglu Army Military Commissioner, Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Grand Councilor, and Commissioner for Editing the National History Wang Jun was demoted to Shang Prefecture Vice-Prefect, supernumerary appointment, and ordered dispatched by express relay from his location.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, privy council commissioner and grand councilor Wang Jun was demoted to supernumerary vice-prefect of Shangzhou and ordered sent away by express relay.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，左監門上將軍李建崇卒。

translations.literal: On the wuchen day, Left Gate General Li Jianchong died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Left Gate general Li Jianchong died.

sentences.zh: 延州牙內都指揮使高紹基奏，交割軍府與副使張圖。

translations.literal: Yan Prefecture Headquarters Commander Gao Shaoji reported handing over the military prefecture to Vice Commissioner Zhang Tu.
translations.idiomatic: Yanzhou headquarters commander Gao Shaoji reported transferring command of the prefecture to vice commissioner Zhang Tu.

sentences.zh: 己巳，朗州劉言奏，當道先遣行軍司馬何敬貞率兵掩擊廣賊，行及潭州，部眾奔潰，湖南王進逵以敬貞失律，已梟首訖。

translations.literal: On the jisi day, Liu Yan of Lang Prefecture reported that this circuit had earlier sent Campaign Marshal He Jingzhen to lead troops in a surprise attack on Guang bandits; when they reached Tan Prefecture the troops broke and fled; Wang Jinkui of Hunan, because Jingzhen had violated discipline, had already beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Liu Yan reported that campaign marshal He Jingzhen had been sent to attack Guang bandits, but his troops broke and fled at Tanzhou. Wang Jinkui of Hunan had executed him for military failure.

sentences.zh: 以樞密直學士、工部侍郎陳觀為秘書監。

translations.literal: Privy Council Academician and Vice Minister of Works Chen Guan was made Director of the Palace Library.
translations.idiomatic: Privy council academician Chen Guan was appointed director of the Palace Library.

sentences.zh: 壬申，鳳翔少尹桑能責授鄧州長史。

translations.literal: On the renshen day, Fengxiang Junior Administrator Sang Neng was demoted to Deng Prefecture Senior Recorder.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Fengxiang junior administrator Sang Neng was demoted to senior recorder of Dengzhou.

sentences.zh: 能，晉相維翰之庶弟也，坐據維翰別第為人所訟故也。

translations.literal: Neng was the younger brother by a concubine of Jin chancellor Wei Han; he was punished for occupying Wei's separate mansion, of which someone had sued him.
translations.idiomatic: Neng was the younger half-brother of Jin chancellor Sang Weihan and was punished for illegally occupying Weihan's private residence.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以戶部侍郎、知貢舉趙上交為太子詹事。

translations.literal: On the guiyou day, Vice Minister of Revenue and Examination Commissioner Zhao Shangjiao was made Steward of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, vice minister of revenue and examination commissioner Zhao Shangjiao was appointed steward of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 是歲，新進士中有李觀者，不當策名，物議喧然，中書門下以觀所試詩賦失韻，勾落姓名，故上交移官。

translations.literal: That year among the new jinshi was one Li Guan who should not have been listed; public discussion was loud. The Secretariat-Chancellery, because Guan's examination poetry and rhapsody had faulty rhyme, struck his name from the list; hence Shangjiao was transferred.
translations.idiomatic: That year a new jinshi named Li Guan provoked public outcry because he should not have passed. The Secretariat struck his name from the rolls for faulty rhyme in his examination poetry, and Shangjiao was transferred as a result.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，幸南莊，賜從官射。

translations.literal: On the dingchou day, the emperor visited the Southern Villa and granted his attendants archery.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, the emperor visited the Southern Villa and granted his attendants an archery session.

sentences.zh: 命客省使向訓權知延州軍州事。

translations.literal: Guest Service Commissioner Xiang Xun was ordered to serve as acting administrator of Yan Prefecture military and civil affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Guest Service commissioner Xiang Xun was appointed acting administrator of Yanzhou.
